# Add NA-safe formatted versions for inline use
fmt_num_na <- function(x, accuracy = 0.01) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", scales::number(x, accuracy = accuracy))
}
fmt_pval_na <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", format_pval(x))
}

format_inv_contrast <- function(row) {
  txt <- paste0(
    "OR = ", fmt_num_na(row$OR[1], 0.01),
    ", *p* = ", fmt_pval_na(row$p.value[1])
  )
  if (isTRUE(row$sensitivity_diff[1])) {
    txt <- paste0(
      txt,
      " (Holm-adjusted *p* = ",
      fmt_pval_na(row$p.value.holm[1]),
      ")"
    )
  }
  txt
}

ret_effect_or_fmt <- fmt_num_na(ret_effect$OR[1], 0.01)
ret_effect_lower_fmt <- fmt_num_na(ret_effect$lower.OR[1], 0.01)
ret_effect_upper_fmt <- fmt_num_na(ret_effect$upper.OR[1], 0.01)
resp_effect_or_fmt <- fmt_num_na(resp_effect$OR[1], 0.01)
resp_effect_lower_fmt <- fmt_num_na(resp_effect$lower.OR[1], 0.01)
resp_effect_upper_fmt <- fmt_num_na(resp_effect$upper.OR[1], 0.01)
resp_effect_p_fmt <- fmt_pval_na(resp_effect$p.value[1])
resp_bpd_contrast_txt <- format_inv_contrast(resp_bpd)
resp_mdd_contrast_txt <- format_inv_contrast(resp_mdd)
ret_bpd_contrast_txt <- format_inv_contrast(ret_bpd)
ret_mdd_contrast_txt <- format_inv_contrast(ret_mdd)
```

Trial-level hierarchical GLMMs (full results in Supplement Table S5) revealed robust retaliation: for every SD decrease in return fairness, the odds of reducing investment increased `r sprintf("%.2f", 1/ret_effect$OR[1])`-fold (95% CI [`r sprintf("%.2f", 1/ret_effect$upper.OR[1])`, `r sprintf("%.2f", 1/ret_effect$lower.OR[1])`], *p* `r ret_effect_phrase`). Positive-reciprocity signals (better-than-fair returns) were not statistically reliable (OR = `r resp_effect_or_fmt`, 95% CI [`r resp_effect_lower_fmt`, `r resp_effect_upper_fmt`], *p* = `r resp_effect_p_fmt`). Focal treatment-versus-control contrasts showed no reliable diagnostic differences in responsiveness (BPD vs CC: `r resp_bpd_contrast_txt`; AD vs CC: `r resp_mdd_contrast_txt`) or retaliation (BPD vs CC: `r ret_bpd_contrast_txt`; AD vs CC: `r ret_mdd_contrast_txt`), indicating that, when controlling for trial context (fairness gaps, prior stakes, round), no reliable diagnostic differences were detected in these tactical-response models.

The attenuated BPD adaptation slopes above (`r scales::percent(abs(bpd_slope / hc_slope - 1), accuracy = 1)` smaller adjustments) coexisted with no reliable group differences in tactical response probabilities. BPD investors adjusted by smaller magnitudes, although the analysis did not detect a group difference in whether participants changed direction after feedback.


```{r investor-round-effects, echo=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
# Extract round spline effects from responsiveness model
resp_round1 <- investor_glmm_table %>% filter(Model == "Responsiveness", term == "splines::ns(round, df = 2)1")
resp_round2 <- investor_glmm_table %>% filter(Model == "Responsiveness", term == "splines::ns(round, df = 2)2")
stopifnot(nrow(resp_round1) == 1L, nrow(resp_round2) == 1L)
resp_round1_p <- resp_round1$p.value
resp_round2_p <- resp_round2$p.value
resp_round1_p_txt <- ifelse(is.na(resp_round1_p), "NA", format_pval(resp_round1_p))
resp_round2_p_txt <- ifelse(is.na(resp_round2_p), "NA", format_pval(resp_round2_p))
```

Comparisons involving the AD investor subgroup ($n = `r n_mdd_investors`$) should be interpreted cautiously, given the limited power associated with this cell despite partial pooling. Both spline terms for round were significant in the responsiveness model (*p* = `r resp_round1_p_txt` and *p* = `r resp_round2_p_txt`), indicating that the probability of increasing stakes following generous returns declined modestly across rounds (OR < 1 for both spline terms). Investors therefore became slightly less responsive to positive signals over time, possibly reflecting adaptation or progressive strategy stabilisation.

```{r investor-feature-anova, results='asis', eval=!rtg_state_ready}
investor_labels <- stats::setNames(investor_metrics$label, investor_metrics$feature)

investor_anova <- purrr::map_dfr(
  investor_metrics %>% dplyr::filter(!.data[["is_rate"]]) %>% pull(feature),
  function(var) {
    data_sub <- investor_features %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]))
    if (nrow(data_sub) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(data_sub$group) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    model <- aov(reformulate("group", response = var), data = data_sub)
    broom::tidy(model) %>%
      dplyr::filter(term == "group") %>%
      mutate(Feature = investor_labels[[var]])
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::select(Feature, df, `F-statistic` = statistic, `p-value` = p.value)

apa_flex(investor_anova,
         caption = "One-way ANOVA tests for investor-derived features across diagnostic groups")


significant_features <- investor_anova %>%
  dplyr::filter(`p-value` < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Feature)

significant_feature_codes <- names(investor_labels[investor_labels %in% significant_features])

investor_pairwise <- purrr::map_dfr(
  significant_feature_codes,
  function(var) {
    data_sub <- investor_features %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]))
    if (nrow(data_sub) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(data_sub$group) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    model <- aov(reformulate("group", response = var), data = data_sub)
    emm <- emmeans(model, "group")
    pairs_tbl <- summary(pairs(emm, adjust = "holm"), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as_tibble()
    if (nrow(pairs_tbl) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    se_vals <- if ("SE" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$SE
    } else if ("std.error" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$std.error
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs_tbl))
    }
    stat_vals <- if ("t.ratio" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$`t.ratio`
    } else if ("z.ratio" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$`z.ratio`
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs_tbl))
    }
    p_vals <- if ("p.value" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$`p.value`
    } else if ("adj.p.value" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$`adj.p.value`
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs_tbl))
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      Feature = investor_labels[[var]],
      contrast = gsub(" - ", " vs ", pairs_tbl$contrast),
      Difference = pairs_tbl$estimate,
      SE = se_vals,
      t.ratio = stat_vals,
      p.value = p_vals
    )
  }
)

if (nrow(investor_pairwise) > 0) {
  apa_flex(investor_pairwise,
           caption = "Holm-adjusted pairwise contrasts for investor behavioural features (significant omnibus only)")
}
```

In summary, BPD investors showed substantially attenuated adjustment of investment following partner returns, whereas tactical response probabilities did not differ reliably across diagnostic groups. That is, BPD investors appeared to detect partner feedback — responding directionally — but to integrate it less strongly into subsequent investment decisions.

Having characterised group differences in trust-giving and adjustment to returns, we next turn to the complementary question of reciprocity in the trustee role. If investor effects reflect altered adaptation to outcomes, trustee effects may reveal altered responsiveness to incoming trust signals.

```{r trustee-lmm-data, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
## ---- Trustee LMM data and helpers ---------------------------------------
## Mirrors the investor workflow: prepare trustee dataset once so the
## downstream chunks can focus solely on model fitting/comparisons.
## 1. Build the trustee dataset with stabilized logit returns
trustee_lme_dat <- clean_dat %>%
  filter(role == "trustee", investment > 0, !is.na(return)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("CC", "BPD", "AD")),
    round_c = scale(round, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[, 1],
    investment_c = scale(investment, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)[, 1],
    return_prop = pmin(pmax(return / (3 * investment), 1e-4), 1 - 1e-4),
    logit_return = qlogis(return_prop)
  )

trust_lmm_old_contrasts <- getOption("contrasts")
options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))

```

```{r trustee-lmm-ml, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
## ---- Trustee LMM ML fits -----------------------------------------------
## Fit the ML hierarchy with retries, discard any unstable stages, and
## assemble AIC/LR summaries for the converged models only.
## 2. Fit the nested ML models under the strict optimizer defined earlier
trust_model_specs <- list(
  list(
    label = "Group only",
    stage = "m0",
    formula = logit_return ~ group + (1 | subject_ID)
  ),
  list(
    label = "Add round + investment",
    stage = "m1",
    formula = logit_return ~ group + round_c + investment_c + (1 | subject_ID)
  ),
  list(
    label = "Add two-way interactions",
    stage = "m2",
    formula = logit_return ~ group * round_c + group * investment_c + round_c * investment_c +
      (1 | subject_ID)
  ),
  list(
    label = "Add three-way interaction",
    stage = "m3",
    formula = logit_return ~ group * round_c * investment_c + (1 | subject_ID)
  )
)

trust_ml_fits <- purrr::map(trust_model_specs, function(spec) {
  fit_obj <- fit_with_retry(
    formula = spec$formula,
    data = trustee_lme_dat,
    label = spec$label,
    REML_flag = FALSE
  )
  if (is.null(fit_obj)) return(NULL)
  c(fit_obj, list(stage = spec$stage, label = spec$label, formula = spec$formula))
}) %>%
  purrr::compact()

if (length(trust_ml_fits) < 2) {
  stop("Fewer than two trustee ML models converged; unable to run likelihood-ratio comparisons.")
}

trust_stage_order <- purrr::map_chr(trust_ml_fits, "stage")
purrr::walk(trust_ml_fits, function(entry) {
  emit_status(sprintf(
    "[Trustee ML] %s retained (optimizer: %s, max|grad| = %s)\n",
    entry$label,
    entry$control_name,
    ifelse(is.null(entry$max_grad), "NA", scales::number(entry$max_grad, accuracy = 0.0001))
  ))
})
trust_model_list <- trust_ml_fits %>%
  purrr::set_names(purrr::map_chr(., "label")) %>%
  purrr::map("fit")

## 3. Compare models via AIC and likelihood-ratio tests
trust_aic_tbl <- tibble(
  Model = names(trust_model_list),
  AIC = purrr::map_dbl(trust_model_list, AIC)
)
trust_lr_raw <- do.call(anova, unname(trust_model_list))
trust_lr_raw_comp <- if (nrow(trust_lr_raw) > 1) trust_lr_raw[-1, , drop = FALSE] else trust_lr_raw[FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
trust_stage_compare <- trust_stage_order[-1]
trust_lr_tbl <- broom::tidy(trust_lr_raw) %>%
  mutate(Model = trust_aic_tbl$Model) %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, everything(), -term)
trust_lr_stage_tbl <- tibble(
  stage = trust_stage_compare,
  Chisq = trust_lr_raw_comp$Chisq,
  Df = trust_lr_raw_comp$Df,
  p = trust_lr_raw_comp$`Pr(>Chisq)`
)
trust_lr_two_way_info <- trust_lr_stage_tbl %>% filter(stage == "m2")
trust_lr_three_way_info <- trust_lr_stage_tbl %>% filter(stage == "m3")
trust_lr_two_way_chisq <- if (nrow(trust_lr_two_way_info) == 0) NA_real_ else trust_lr_two_way_info$Chisq
trust_lr_two_way_df <- if (nrow(trust_lr_two_way_info) == 0) NA_real_ else trust_lr_two_way_info$Df
trust_lr_two_way_p <- if (nrow(trust_lr_two_way_info) == 0) NA_real_ else trust_lr_two_way_info$p
trust_lr_three_way_p <- if (nrow(trust_lr_three_way_info) == 0) NA_real_ else trust_lr_three_way_info$p
```

```{r trustee-lmm-reml, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
## ---- Trustee LMM REML + diagnostics ------------------------------------
## Select the LR-backed model, refit with REML (retrying optimizers if
## needed), emit convergence info, and gather diagnostics for reporting.
## 4. Select the simplest model that materially improves fit
trust_lr_pvals <- trust_lr_raw$`Pr(>Chisq)`
trust_best_index <- 1
trust_comparison_indices <- seq_along(trust_lr_pvals)
if (length(trust_comparison_indices) > 1) {
  for (i in trust_comparison_indices[-1]) {
    pval <- trust_lr_pvals[i]
    if (is.na(pval) || pval >= 0.05) break
    trust_best_index <- i
  }
}
trust_best_entry <- trust_ml_fits[[trust_best_index]]
trust_best_label <- trust_best_entry$label

## 5. Refit with REML for inference and inspect gradients
trust_best_reml <- fit_with_retry(
  formula = trust_best_entry$formula,
  data = trustee_lme_dat,
  label = paste0(trust_best_label, " (REML)"),
  REML_flag = TRUE
)
if (is.null(trust_best_reml)) {
  stop("Selected trustee model failed to converge under REML.")
}
trust_lmm <- trust_best_reml$fit
trust_max_grad <- trust_best_reml$max_grad
trust_max_grad_fmt <- ifelse(
  is.na(trust_max_grad),
  "NA",
  scales::number(trust_max_grad, accuracy = 0.0001)
)

emit_status(sprintf(
  "[Trustee LMM] Selected model: %s | max|grad| = %s\n",
  trust_best_label, trust_max_grad_fmt
))

trustee_random_effect_note <- "Simpler trustee models retained the random slope for investment, but the more parameter-rich specifications required by the LR procedure did not converge with that structure. We therefore report the converged models with random intercepts, noting that attempts with random investment slopes failed to meet gradient tolerances."

## 6. Residual diagnostics (reported in Methods text)
trust_res <- residuals(trust_lmm)
trust_fit <- fitted(trust_lmm)
trust_z <- as.numeric(scale(trust_res))
trust_outlier_pct <- mean(abs(trust_z) > 3, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
set.seed(2)
trust_sw <- shapiro.test(sample(trust_res, min(5000, length(trust_res))))
trust_centered <- trust_res - mean(trust_res)
trust_sd <- sd(trust_res)
trust_skew <- ifelse(trust_sd > 0, mean(trust_centered^3) / (trust_sd^3), NA_real_)
trust_kurt <- ifelse(trust_sd > 0, mean(trust_centered^4) / (trust_sd^4) - 3, NA_real_)
trust_breaks <- unique(quantile(trust_fit, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 11), na.rm = TRUE))
if (length(trust_breaks) < 2 || all(!is.finite(trust_breaks))) trust_breaks <- range(trust_fit, na.rm = TRUE)
trust_bins <- tryCatch(cut(trust_fit, breaks = trust_breaks, include_lowest = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
trust_var_by_bin <- if (is.null(trust_bins)) NA_real_ else tapply(trust_res, trust_bins, var, na.rm = TRUE)
trust_var_ratio <- if (all(is.na(trust_var_by_bin))) NA_real_ else {
  max(trust_var_by_bin, na.rm = TRUE) / max(min(trust_var_by_bin, na.rm = TRUE), .Machine$double.eps)
}

## ---- Generate Supplement Table S4: Complete Trustee LMM Output --------
trust_lmm_summary <- summary(trust_lmm)
trust_coef_table <- as.data.frame(coef(trust_lmm_summary))
trust_coef_table$Parameter <- rownames(trust_coef_table)
trust_coef_table <- trust_coef_table[, c("Parameter", "Estimate", "Std. Error", "df", "t value", "Pr(>|t|)")]
colnames(trust_coef_table) <- c("Parameter", "Estimate", "SE", "df", "t", "p")

# Format for supplement
trust_coef_supp <- trust_coef_table %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = sprintf("%.4f", Estimate),
    SE = sprintf("%.4f", SE),
    df = sprintf("%.1f", df),
    t = sprintf("%.2f", t),
    p = ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
  )

# Save to supplement folder
if (!dir.exists("supplement")) dir.create("supplement")
write.csv(trust_coef_supp, "supplement/TableS4_Trustee_LMM_Complete.csv", row.names = FALSE)

emit_status("\n[Supplement S4] Saved complete Trustee LMM output table\n")

options(contrasts = trust_lmm_old_contrasts)
```

### Reciprocity sensitivity to investment across trials

Following the analytic approach described for investors, we fitted nested models to the trial-level proportion of the tripled investment returned, calculated as `return / (3 × investment)`. Trials with zero investment were excluded because this proportion is undefined. For the remaining trials, proportions of exactly 0 or 1 were recoded to 0.0001 and 0.9999, respectively, before modelling. The descriptive summaries above averaged the same proportions within participants, whereas the mixed-effects model retained individual trials and estimated how return proportions varied with group, round, and investment. Diagnostic group, centered round, centered investment, and their interactions entered as fixed effects. Likelihood-ratio tests selected the two-way interaction model ($\chi^2$ = `r scales::number(trust_lr_two_way_chisq, accuracy = 0.01)`, df = `r trust_lr_two_way_df`, *p* `r format_pval_clause(trust_lr_two_way_p)` vs. main-effects only); the three-way interaction offered no improvement (*p* `r format_pval_clause(trust_lr_three_way_p)`). As noted in Methods, random-slope specifications for investment were not retained as acceptable fits, so we report random-intercept specifications only. Convergence checks for the retained LMMs are described in Supplement S1.2.

# Safe accessor function to handle missing columns or empty data
safe_get <- function(df, col, idx = 1, default = NA) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || !(col %in% names(df))) return(default)
  cols <- names(df)
  col_idx <- which(cols == col)
  if (length(col_idx) == 0) {
    col_idx <- which(tolower(cols) == tolower(col))
  }
  if (length(col_idx) == 0) return(default)
  val <- df[[col_idx]][idx]
  if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0) return(default)
  val
}

trust_pull <- function(param, col = "Estimate", default = NA_real_) {
  if (!"Parameter" %in% names(trust_coef_table)) return(default)
  idx <- which(trust_coef_table$Parameter == param)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(default)
  val <- trust_coef_table[[col]][idx[1]]
  if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0) return(default)
  val
}

get_contrast_row <- function(df, label) {
  row <- df %>% filter(contrast == label)
  if (nrow(row) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      estimate = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      lower.CL = NA_real_,
      upper.CL = NA_real_
    ))

  row
}

mdd_p_raw <- mdd_vs_cc_row$p.value[1]

bpd_p_holm_fmt <- fmt_pval(bpd_p_holm)
mdd_p_holm_fmt <- fmt_pval(mdd_p_holm)

diag_main_effect_summary <- dplyr::case_when(
  is.na(bpd_p_holm) | is.na(mdd_p_holm) ~
    "Diagnostic main effects could not be estimated robustly for one or both contrasts.",
  bpd_p_holm < 0.05 & mdd_p_holm < 0.05 ~
    "Under Holm-adjusted inference, both diagnostic contrasts remained statistically significant at the model's reference point—the sample's average round and investment.",
  bpd_p_holm < 0.05 & mdd_p_holm >= 0.05 ~
    "Under Holm-adjusted inference, only the BPD vs CC contrast remained statistically significant at the model's reference point—the sample's average round and investment.",
  bpd_p_holm >= 0.05 & mdd_p_holm < 0.05 ~
    "Under Holm-adjusted inference, only the AD vs CC contrast remained statistically significant at the model's reference point—the sample's average round and investment.",
  TRUE ~
    "Under Holm-adjusted inference, neither diagnostic contrast was statistically significant at the model's reference point—the sample's average round and investment."
)

lmm_sensitivity_note <- if ((bpd_p_raw < 0.05) != (bpd_p_holm < 0.05) ||
                            (mdd_p_raw < 0.05) != (mdd_p_holm < 0.05)) {
  paste0(
    " Raw focal contrasts are shown for transparency; Holm adjustment altered the inferential status of at least one contrast",
    " (BPD vs CC: *p* = ", bpd_p_holm_fmt,
    "; AD vs CC: *p* = ", mdd_p_holm_fmt, ")."
  )
} else {
  " Raw focal contrasts are shown for transparency; Holm adjustment did not change the inferential status of these contrasts."
}

# Extract values safely
mdd_vs_hc_est <- safe_get(mdd_vs_cc_row, "estimate")
mdd_vs_hc_ci_low <- safe_get(mdd_vs_cc_row, "lower.CL")
mdd_vs_hc_ci_high <- safe_get(mdd_vs_cc_row, "upper.CL")
mdd_vs_hc_p <- safe_get(mdd_vs_cc_row, "p.value")

# Format values for inline reporting
mdd_vs_hc_diff_fmt <- if (is.na(mdd_vs_hc_est)) "n/a" else scales::number(mdd_vs_hc_est * 100, accuracy = 0.1)
mdd_vs_hc_ci_low_fmt <- if (is.na(mdd_vs_hc_ci_low)) "n/a" else scales::number(mdd_vs_hc_ci_low * 100, accuracy = 0.1)
mdd_vs_hc_ci_high_fmt <- if (is.na(mdd_vs_hc_ci_high)) "n/a" else scales::number(mdd_vs_hc_ci_high * 100, accuracy = 0.1)
mdd_vs_hc_p_fmt <- if (is.na(mdd_vs_hc_p)) {
  "n/a"
} else if (mdd_vs_hc_p < 0.001) {
  "< .001"
} else {
  format_pval(mdd_vs_hc_p)
}
mdd_vs_hc_sig <- if (is.na(mdd_vs_hc_p)) {
  "difference that could not be estimated"
} else if (mdd_vs_hc_p < 0.05) {
  "significant difference"
} else {
  "non-significant difference"
}

```

Key findings (Supplement Table S8): investment amount strongly predicted the proportion of the tripled endowment returned (\(\beta_{\text{invest}} = `r inv_beta`\), \(t = `r inv_t`\), *p* `r format_pval_clause(trust_pull("investment_c", "p"))`), with trustees reciprocating more generously to larger stakes. A significant round × investment interaction (\(\beta_{\text{round}\times \text{invest}} = `r roundinv_beta`\), \(t = `r roundinv_t`\), *p* `r format_pval_clause(trust_pull("round_c:investment_c", "p"))`) indicated increasing investment sensitivity over time. Raw focal treatment-versus-control contrasts at the centered reference point were BPD vs CC: \(\Delta = `r bpd_beta`\), *p* `r format_pval_clause(bpd_vs_cc_row$p.value[1])`\; AD vs CC: \(\Delta = `r mdd_beta`\), *p* `r format_pval_clause(mdd_vs_cc_row$p.value[1])`. `r diag_main_effect_summary` This conditional comparison differs from comparing each participant's returns across the whole game. `r lmm_sensitivity_note`

We therefore examined whether trial-level tactical behaviours revealed diagnostic differences not apparent in mean return levels.

### Tactical Responses: Coaxing, Encouragement, and Cooperation Pick-up

```{r trustee-tactical-models, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
trustee_tactical_old_contrasts <- getOption("contrasts")
options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))

trustee_trial_base <- clean_dat %>%
  filter(role == "trustee", !is.na(lag_investment), !is.na(group)) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_invest_sc = z_score(lag_investment),
    curr_invest_sc = z_score(investment),
    prev_fair_gap = dplyr::coalesce(lag_fair_gap, 0),
    prev_fair_gap_sc = z_score(prev_fair_gap),
    eligible_coax = investment > 0 & investment <= 5,
    eligible_encour = investment < lag_investment & lag_return < 3 * investment,
    eligible_pickup = investment > lag_investment & lag_return < 3 * investment
  )

trustee_coax_df <- trustee_trial_base %>% filter(eligible_coax, !is.na(trustee_coaxing_event))
trustee_encour_df <- trustee_trial_base %>% filter(eligible_encour, !is.na(trustee_encouragement_event))
trustee_pickup_df <- trustee_trial_base %>% filter(eligible_pickup, !is.na(trustee_coop_pickup_event))

fit_trustee_candidate <- function(formula, data) {
  tryCatch(
    glmer(
      formula,
      family = binomial,
      data = data,
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

trustee_glmm_has_issue <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(TRUE)
  !is.null(fit@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages) || isSingular(fit, tol = 1e-4)
}

mk_trustee_glmm <- function(mod, label) {
  res <- broom.mixed::tidy(mod, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)
  if (!"p.value" %in% names(res)) {
    res <- res %>% mutate(p.value = 2 * stats::pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE))
  }
  res %>%
    mutate(
      Model = label,
      raw_term = term,
      Term = paste0(clean_tactical_term(term), add_stars(p.value))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Model,
      term = raw_term,
      Term,
      OR = estimate,
      Statistic = statistic,
      p.value,
      lower.OR = conf.low,
      upper.OR = conf.high
    )
}

mk_trustee_contrasts <- function(mod, label, feature_name) {
  contrast_df <- summary(
    contrast(
      emmeans(mod, ~ group),
      method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
      ref = "CC",
      adjust = "none"
    ),
    infer = TRUE,
    type = "response"
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()
  contrast_df_holm <- summary(
    contrast(
      emmeans(mod, ~ group),
      method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
      ref = "CC",
      adjust = "holm"
    ),
    infer = TRUE,
    type = "response"
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    transmute(
      Contrast = gsub("\\s*/\\s*", " - ", contrast),
      p.value.holm = p.value
    )

  lower_col <- intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(contrast_df))
  upper_col <- intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(contrast_df))

  contrast_df %>%
    transmute(
      Model = label,
      feature = feature_name,
      Contrast = gsub("\\s*/\\s*", " - ", contrast),
      OR = odds.ratio,
      lower.OR = .data[[lower_col[1]]],
      upper.OR = .data[[upper_col[1]]],
      p.value = p.value,
      sig = p.value < 0.05
    ) %>%
    left_join(contrast_df_holm, by = "Contrast") %>%
    mutate(
      sig.holm = p.value.holm < 0.05,
      sensitivity_diff = sig != sig.holm
    )
}

mk_trustee_preds <- function(mod, feature_name) {
  pred_df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ group, type = "response"))
  lower_col <- intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(pred_df))
  upper_col <- intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(pred_df))

  pred_df %>%
    transmute(
      group = factor(group, levels = c("CC", "BPD", "AD")),
      feature = feature_name,
      mean_rate = prob,
      lower = .data[[lower_col[1]]],
      upper = .data[[upper_col[1]]]
    )
}

fit_trustee_tactical_model <- function(data, response, label, feature_name) {
  if (nrow(data) < 10 || dplyr::n_distinct(data$subject_ID) < 5) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  slope_formula <- as.formula(glue::glue(
    "{response} ~ curr_invest_sc + prev_invest_sc + prev_fair_gap_sc + splines::ns(round, df = 2) + group + (1 + curr_invest_sc | subject_ID)"
  ))
  intercept_formula <- as.formula(glue::glue(
    "{response} ~ curr_invest_sc + prev_invest_sc + prev_fair_gap_sc + splines::ns(round, df = 2) + group + (1 | subject_ID)"
  ))

  slope_fit <- fit_trustee_candidate(slope_formula, data)
  use_slope <- !trustee_glmm_has_issue(slope_fit)
  final_fit <- if (use_slope) slope_fit else fit_trustee_candidate(intercept_formula, data)
  if (is.null(final_fit)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  coef_full <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(final_fit)))
  coef_full$Parameter <- rownames(coef_full)
  coef_full$Model <- label
  coef_full$RandomEffects <- if (use_slope) "random slope for current investment" else "random intercept only"

  list(
    label = label,
    feature = feature_name,
    model = final_fit,
    structure = if (use_slope) "random slope for current investment" else "random intercept only",
    downgraded = !use_slope,
    fixed_table = mk_trustee_glmm(final_fit, label),
    pairwise = mk_trustee_contrasts(final_fit, label, feature_name),
    preds = mk_trustee_preds(final_fit, feature_name),
    coef_full = coef_full
  )
}

trustee_tactical_results <- list(
  "Coaxing" = fit_trustee_tactical_model(
    trustee_coax_df,
    "trustee_coaxing_event",
    "Coaxing",
    "trust_coaxing_rate"
  ),
  "Encouragement" = fit_trustee_tactical_model(
    trustee_encour_df,
    "trustee_encouragement_event",
    "Encouragement",
    "trust_encouragement_rate"
  ),
  "Cooperation pick-up" = fit_trustee_tactical_model(
    trustee_pickup_df,
    "trustee_coop_pickup_event",
    "Cooperation pick-up",
    "trust_coop_pickup_rate"
  )
)

trustee_glmm_tables <- purrr::map(trustee_tactical_results, "fixed_table") %>% purrr::compact()
trustee_glmm_table <- if (length(trustee_glmm_tables) > 0) bind_rows(trustee_glmm_tables) else tibble::tibble()

trustee_glmm_print <- trustee_glmm_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, Term, OR, Statistic, p.value, lower.OR, upper.OR) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`p-value` = p.value, `OR Low` = lower.OR, `OR High` = upper.OR) %>%
  mutate(
    OR = round(OR, 2),
    Statistic = round(Statistic, 2),
    `p-value` = signif(`p-value`, 3),
    `OR Low` = round(`OR Low`, 2),
    `OR High` = round(`OR High`, 2)
  )

trustee_tactical_contrasts <- purrr::map(trustee_tactical_results, "pairwise") %>%
  purrr::compact() %>%
  bind_rows()

trustee_tactical_preds <- purrr::map(trustee_tactical_results, "preds") %>%
  purrr::compact() %>%
  bind_rows()

coax_structure <- trustee_tactical_results[["Coaxing"]]$structure
encour_structure <- trustee_tactical_results[["Encouragement"]]$structure
pickup_structure <- trustee_tactical_results[["Cooperation pick-up"]]$structure

trustee_tactical_structure_text <- paste0(
  "Random-effects structure for tactical trustee models: Coaxing used ",
  coax_structure,
  "; Encouragement used ",
  encour_structure,
  "; Cooperation pick-up used ",
  pickup_structure,
  "."
)

options(contrasts = trustee_tactical_old_contrasts)

```{r trustee-behaviour-panel, fig.cap="Trustee return behaviour by group. Panel A shows trial-level return-proportion distributions as coloured violins and white boxplots; overlaid points show participant-level means across the 10 rounds. Panels B–D show GLMM-predicted probabilities, with points indicating predicted probabilities and vertical bars 95% confidence intervals. Panel B shows coaxing, defined as returning at least the invested amount after a low but non-zero investment. Panel C shows encouragement, defined as returning more tokens than in the preceding round when the investor sent fewer. Panel D shows cooperation pick-up, defined as returning more tokens when the investor sent more. Colours denote group. Brackets and asterisks mark CC-referenced contrasts that remained significant after Holm correction.", include=TRUE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, out.width='100%', fig.pos='!t'}
library(patchwork)

# Helper to format significance stars
get_stars <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

tactical_summary <- trustee_tactical_preds
tactical_contrasts <- trustee_tactical_contrasts

# Colors consistent with other figures (use global group_colors)
diag_colors <- group_colors[c("CC", "BPD", "AD")]

# Create individual panels with zoomed y-axis
create_tactical_panel <- function(feat, title) {
  plot_data <- tactical_summary %>% filter(feature == feat)
  contrast_data <- tactical_contrasts %>% filter(feature == feat)
  
  # Calculate y-axis limits to zoom in on the data
  min_y <- min(plot_data$lower, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_y <- max(plot_data$upper, na.rm = TRUE)
  range_y <- max_y - min_y
  
  # Add padding for brackets (15% below, 25% above for brackets)
  y_lower <- max(0, min_y - range_y * 0.15)
  y_upper <- max_y + range_y * 0.5  # Extra space for brackets
  
  step <- range_y * 0.15  # Bracket step based on data range
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = group, y = mean_rate, color = group)) +
    geom_point(size = 5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = diag_colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), 
                       limits = c(y_lower, y_upper),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
    labs(title = title, y = "Rate", x = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90")
    )
  
  # Add significance brackets for all pairwise contrasts (CC-BPD, CC-AD, BPD-AD)
  pair_map <- list(
    "BPD - CC" = c(1, 2),
    "CC - BPD" = c(1, 2),
    "AD - CC" = c(1, 3),
    "CC - AD" = c(1, 3),
    "AD - BPD" = c(2, 3),
    "BPD - AD" = c(2, 3)
  )
  if (nrow(contrast_data) > 0) {
    y_pos <- max_y + step * 0.5
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(contrast_data))) {
      row <- contrast_data[i, ]
      # Robust mapping: parse group names from contrast label (handles "/" or "-")
      parts <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(row$Contrast), "\\s*/\\s*|\\s*-\\s*"))
      if (length(parts) != 2) next
      xpos <- match(parts, c("CC", "BPD", "AD"))
      if (any(is.na(xpos))) next
      xpos <- sort(xpos)
      if (is.null(xpos) || !row$sig.holm) next
      p <- p +
        annotate("segment", x = xpos[1], xend = xpos[2], y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
        annotate("segment", x = xpos[1], xend = xpos[1], y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - step * 0.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
        annotate("segment", x = xpos[2], xend = xpos[2], y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - step * 0.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
        annotate("text", x = mean(xpos), y = y_pos + step * 0.25, label = get_stars(row$p.value.holm), size = 6, fontface = "bold")
      y_pos <- y_pos + step * 0.7
    }
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Create three tactical panels
p_coax <- create_tactical_panel("trust_coaxing_rate", "B. Coaxing\n(Return matches or exceeds investment)")
p_encour <- create_tactical_panel("trust_encouragement_rate", "C. Encouragement\n(Return rises when investment falls)")
p_pickup <- create_tactical_panel("trust_coop_pickup_rate", "D. Cooperation Pick-up\n(Return rises when investment rises)")

# Combine the return distribution and tactical-response panels
trustee_return_distribution_plot + p_coax + p_encour + p_pickup +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2)

```{r trustee-glmm-extract, echo=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
missing_continuous_terms <- !any(trustee_glmm_table$term %in% c("curr_invest_sc", "prev_invest_sc", "prev_fair_gap_sc"))

get_trustee_contrast <- function(model_label, contrast_label) {
  row <- trustee_tactical_contrasts %>%
    filter(Model == model_label, Contrast == contrast_label)
  if (nrow(row) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      Contrast = contrast_label,
      OR = NA_real_,
      lower.OR = NA_real_,
      upper.OR = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      p.value.holm = NA_real_,
      sensitivity_diff = FALSE
    ))
  }
  row[1, ]
}

format_trustee_contrast <- function(row) {
  txt <- paste0(
    row$Contrast, ": OR = ", scales::number(row$OR, accuracy = 0.01),
    " (95% CI [", scales::number(row$lower.OR, accuracy = 0.01), ", ",
    scales::number(row$upper.OR, accuracy = 0.01), "], *p* ",
    ifelse(row$p.value < 0.001, "< .001", paste0("= ", format_pval(row$p.value))),
    ")"
  )
  if (isTRUE(row$sensitivity_diff)) {
    txt <- paste0(
      txt,
      " (Holm-adjusted *p* ",
      ifelse(row$p.value.holm < 0.001, "< .001", paste0("= ", format_pval(row$p.value.holm))),
      ")"
    )
  }
  txt
}

)
pickup_diag_text <- paste(
  format_trustee_contrast(pickup_bpd_vs_cc),
  format_trustee_contrast(pickup_ad_vs_cc),
  sep = "; "
)

trustee_rate_opps <- trustee_features %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    coax_opps = sum(trust_coaxing_opportunities, na.rm = TRUE),
    encour_opps = sum(trust_encouragement_opportunities, na.rm = TRUE),
    pickup_opps = sum(trust_coop_pickup_opportunities, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

AD trustees showed some elevation in prosocial tactical behaviours (Figure \@ref(fig:trustee-behaviour-panel)B–D). These tactical effects were directionally consistent with the broader AD pattern, but were more modest and less robust than the HMM findings. Within the tactical models, encouragement was higher in AD than CC (`r encour_diag_text`), but this effect attenuated in the demographic and administration-mode sensitivity analyses and should therefore be treated as provisional. Coaxing showed a nominal AD > CC difference on the focal unadjusted contrast (`r coax_diag_text`), but this did not survive Holm correction and should therefore be treated cautiously. BPD trustees did not differ reliably from CC on either behaviour. Cooperation pick-up—increasing returns when investors increased stakes—showed no reliable diagnostic group differences: `r pickup_diag_text`. `r trustee_tactical_structure_text` Full GLMM results are in Supplement Table S9.

```{r trustee-feature-anova, results='asis', eval=!rtg_state_ready}
trustee_labels <- stats::setNames(trustee_metrics$label, trustee_metrics$feature)

trustee_anova <- purrr::map_dfr(
  trustee_metrics %>% dplyr::filter(!.data[["is_rate"]]) %>% pull(feature),
  function(var) {
    data_sub <- trustee_features %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]))
    if (nrow(data_sub) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(data_sub$group) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    model <- aov(reformulate("group", response = var), data = data_sub)
    broom::tidy(model) %>%
      dplyr::filter(term == "group") %>%
      mutate(Feature = trustee_labels[[var]])
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::select(Feature, df, `F-statistic` = statistic, `p-value` = p.value)

apa_flex(trustee_anova,
         caption = "One-way ANOVA tests for trustee-derived features across diagnostic groups")

```{r trustee-feature-pairwise, results='markup', eval=!rtg_state_ready}
significant_trustee_features <- trustee_anova %>%
  dplyr::filter(`p-value` < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Feature)

significant_trustee_codes <- names(trustee_labels[trustee_labels %in% significant_trustee_features])

trustee_pairwise <- purrr::map_dfr(
  significant_trustee_codes,
  function(var) {
    data_sub <- trustee_features %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]))
    if (nrow(data_sub) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(data_sub$group) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    model <- aov(reformulate("group", response = var), data = data_sub)
    emm <- emmeans(model, "group")
    pairs_tbl <- summary(pairs(emm, adjust = "holm"), infer = TRUE) %>%
      as_tibble()
    if (nrow(pairs_tbl) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    se_vals <- if ("SE" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$SE
    } else if ("std.error" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$std.error
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs_tbl))
    }
    stat_vals <- if ("t.ratio" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$`t.ratio`
    } else if ("z.ratio" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$`z.ratio`
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs_tbl))
    }
    p_vals <- if ("p.value" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$`p.value`
    } else if ("adj.p.value" %in% names(pairs_tbl)) {
      pairs_tbl$`adj.p.value`
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs_tbl))
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      Feature = trustee_labels[[var]],
      contrast = gsub(" - ", " vs ", pairs_tbl$contrast),
      Difference = pairs_tbl$estimate,
      SE = se_vals,
      t.ratio = stat_vals,
      p.value = p_vals
    )
  }
)

if (nrow(trustee_pairwise) > 0) {
  apa_flex(trustee_pairwise,
           caption = "Holm-adjusted pairwise contrasts for trustee behavioural features (significant omnibus only)")
}
```

In summary, diagnostic groups did not differ reliably in average return proportions overall. The clearest AD-related differences in this manuscript come from the HMM analyses reported below, particularly relative to BPD under hesitant partner signals; within the tactical models, encouragement was higher in AD than CC but should be treated as provisional. The coaxing effect was nominal and sensitive to Holm correction, and cooperation pick-up did not differ significantly across groups.

The behavioural patterns reported above could reflect either maladaptive strategies associated with reduced earnings or alternative but economically viable interpersonal styles. To distinguish between these possibilities, we next examined total economic outcomes.

\FloatBarrier

Despite the clear behavioural differences in reciprocity and responsiveness, we failed to detect statistically significant differences in total game payoffs across diagnostic groups (trustees: F(`r round(trustee_payoff_df1, 0)`, `r round(trustee_payoff_df2, 0)`) = `r scales::number(trustee_payoff_F, accuracy = 0.01)`, *p* = `r format_pval(trustee_payoff_p)`; investors: F(`r round(investor_payoff_df1, 0)`, `r round(investor_payoff_df2, 0)`) = `r scales::number(investor_payoff_F, accuracy = 0.01)`, *p* = `r format_pval(investor_payoff_p)`; Supplement Tables S21–S22). Holm-adjusted post hoc tests were uniformly non-significant.

## Latent state dynamics

Having examined diagnostic differences in aggregate metrics and tactical behaviours, we next turned to the underlying reciprocity dynamics using HMMs.

```{r, include=F, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
############### HMM support functions (hidden - methodology in Methods section) #########################

# order the states of the HMM to allow it to order them as low ret/mid/ret/high ret. 
label_switch <- function(mod,labels) {
  # labels is vector, first element is new label for original state 1, second is new label for original state 2, etc.
  if(!is(mod,"depmix") && !is(mod,"depmix.fitted")) stop("this function is for depmix models")
  n_states <- mod@nstates
  if(length(labels) != n_states || length(unique(labels)) != n_states || !(all(labels) %in% 1:n_states)) {
    stop("labels needs to be a vector of unique integers between 1 and ", n_states)
  }
  inv_labels <- sapply(1:n_states,function(x) which(labels == x))
  tmp <- mod
  # relabel prior
  ppars <- getpars(mod@prior)
  fpars <- getpars(mod@prior,which="fixed")
  out_pars <- as.numeric(t(matrix(ppars,nrow=length(ppars)/n_states,byrow = TRUE)[,inv_labels]))
  out_fixed <- as.logical(t(matrix(fpars,nrow=length(fpars)/n_states,byrow = TRUE)[,inv_labels]))
  if(!tmp@prior@family$link=="identity") tmp@prior@family$base <- labels[tmp@prior@family$base]
  # relabel transition
  for(i in 1:n_states) {
    ppars <- getpars(mod@transition[[inv_labels[i]]])
    fpars <- getpars(mod@transition[[inv_labels[i]]],which="fixed")
    out_pars <- c(out_pars,as.numeric(t(matrix(ppars,nrow=length(ppars)/n_states,byrow = TRUE)[,inv_labels])))
    out_fixed <- c(out_fixed,as.logical(t(matrix(fpars,nrow=length(fpars)/n_states,byrow = TRUE)[,inv_labels])))
    tmp@transition[[i]] <- mod@transition[[inv_labels[i]]]
    if(!tmp@transition[[i]]@family$link=="identity") tmp@transition[[i]]@family$base <- labels[tmp@transition[[i]]@family$base]
    #out_pars <- c(out_pars,getpars(mod@transition[[inv_labels[i]]]))
  }
  # relabel response
  for(i in 1:n_states) {
    out_pars <- c(out_pars,unlist(lapply(mod@response[[inv_labels[i]]],getpars)))
    out_fixed <- c(out_fixed,unlist(lapply(mod@response[[inv_labels[i]]],getpars,which="fixed")))
  }
  tmp <- setpars(tmp,out_fixed,which="fixed")
  tmp <- setpars(tmp,out_pars)
  if(is(tmp,"depmix.fitted")) tmp@posterior <- viterbi(tmp)
  return(tmp)
}

# ordering states for a truncated discretised Gaussian (For Investor Model)
order_mod_truncdiscgaus <- function(mod) {
  ns <- nstates(mod)
  sum <- rep(0.0,ns)
  for(i in 1:ns) {
    # Expected return in each state calculation
    tpars <- getpars(mod@response[[i]][[1]])
    dmod <- truncdiscgaus(seq(0, 20), pstart = tpars, min=-0.5, max=20.5)
    sum[i] <- sum(seq(0,20)*dens(dmod))
  }
  cat("Expected values for states: ",sum, "\n")
  # reordering the states
  mod <- label_switch(mod, rank(sum, ties.method = "first"))
  return(mod)
}

# ordering states for a variable response truncated discretised Gaussian (for trustee model)
order_mod_vtdgaus <- function(mod) {
  ns <- nstates(mod)
  sum <- rep(0.0,ns)
  for(i in 1:ns) {
    # Expected return in each state calculation
    tpars <- getpars(mod@response[[i]][[1]])
    dmod <- vtdgaus(seq(0, 1, length=61), pstart = tpars, yield=rep(60, 61))
    sum[i] <- sum(seq(0, 1, length=61)*dens(dmod))
  }
  # reordering the states
  mod <- label_switch(mod, rank(sum, ties.method = "first"))
  return(mod)
}

```


```{r,include=F}
# define a response class which only contains the standard slots, no additional slots
setClass("discgaus", contains="response", slots=c(breaks="numeric"))

# define a generic for the method defining the response class

setGeneric("discgaus", function(y, pstart = NULL, fixed = NULL, ...) standardGeneric("discgaus"))

# define the method that creates the response class

setMethod("discgaus", 
          signature(y="ANY"), 
          function(y,pstart=NULL,fixed=NULL, breaks = c(-Inf, seq(0, 19) + .5, Inf), ...) {
            y <- matrix(y,length(y))
            x <- matrix(1)
            parameters <- list()
            npar <- 2
            if(is.null(fixed)) fixed <- as.logical(rep(0,npar))
            if(!is.null(pstart)) {
              if(length(pstart)!=npar) stop("length of 'pstart' must be ",npar)
              parameters$mu <- pstart[1]
              parameters$sigma <- pstart[2]
            } else {
              parameters <- list(mu = 10, sigma = 3)
            }
            mod <- new("discgaus",parameters=parameters,fixed=fixed,x=x,y=y,npar=npar, breaks=breaks)
            mod
          }
)

setMethod("show","discgaus",
          function(object) {
            cat("Gaussian with discrete support\n")
            cat("Parameters: \n")
            cat("mu: ", object@parameters$mu, "\n")
            cat("sigma: ", object@parameters$sigma, "\n")
          }
)

setMethod("dens","discgaus",
          function(object,log=FALSE) {
            p <- pnorm(object@breaks[-1], mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma) - pnorm(object@breaks[-length(object@breaks)], mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma)
            if(log) return(log(p[as.numeric(cut(object@y, breaks=object@breaks))])) else return(p[as.numeric(cut(object@y, breaks=object@breaks))])
          }
)

setMethod("setpars","discgaus",
          function(object, values, which="pars", ...) {
            npar <- npar(object)
            if(length(values)!=npar) stop("length of 'values' must be",npar)
            # determine whether parameters or fixed constraints are being set
            nms <- names(object@parameters)
            switch(which,
                   "pars"= {
                     object@parameters$mu <- values[1]
                     object@parameters$sigma <- values[2]
                   },
                   "fixed" = {
                     object@fixed <- as.logical(values)
                   }
            )
            names(object@parameters) <- nms
            return(object)
          }
)

setMethod("getpars","discgaus",
          function(object,which="pars",...) {
            switch(which,
                   "pars" = {
                     parameters <- numeric()
                     parameters <- unlist(object@parameters)
                     pars <- parameters
                   },
                   "fixed" = {
                     pars <- object@fixed
                   }
            )
            return(pars)
          }
)

setMethod("fit","discgaus",
          function(object,w) {
            if(missing(w)) w <- NULL
            if(!is.null(w)) {
              negLL <- function(pars) {
                object <- setpars(object, c(pars[1], exp(pars[2])))
                -sum(w*log(dens(object)))
              }
            } else {
              negLL <- function(pars) {
                object <- setpars(object, c(pars[1], exp(pars[2])))
                -sum(log(dens(object)))
              }
            }
            pars <- optim(c(object@parameters$mu, log(object@parameters$sigma)), fn=negLL)$par
            object <- setpars(object,c(pars[1], exp(pars[2])))
            object
          }
)

setClass("truncdiscgaus", contains="discgaus", slots=c(min="numeric", max="numeric"))

setMethod("dens","truncdiscgaus",
          function(object,log=FALSE) {
            breaks <- c(object@min, object@breaks[object@breaks > object@min & object@breaks < object@max], object@max)
            prec <- pnorm(object@max, mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma) - pnorm(object@min, mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma)
            if(prec < 1e-12) {
              # return uniform probabilities as precision is likely off
              p <- rep(1/(length(breaks)-1), length(object@y))
              if(log) return(log(p)) else return(p)
            } else {
              p <- pnorm(breaks[-1], mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma) - pnorm(breaks[-length(breaks)], mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma)
              p <- p/sum(p)
              if(log) return(log(p[as.numeric(cut(object@y, breaks=object@breaks))])) else return(p[as.numeric(cut(object@y, breaks=object@breaks))])
            }
          }
)

setGeneric("truncdiscgaus", function(y, pstart = NULL, fixed = NULL, ...) standardGeneric("truncdiscgaus"))

setMethod("truncdiscgaus", 
          signature(y="ANY"), 
          function(y,pstart=NULL,fixed=NULL, breaks = c(-Inf, seq(0, 19) + .5, Inf), min=-0.5, max=20.5, ...) {
            y <- matrix(y,length(y))
            x <- matrix(1)
            parameters <- list()
            npar <- 2
            if(is.null(fixed)) fixed <- as.logical(rep(0,npar))
            if(!is.null(pstart)) {
              if(length(pstart)!=npar) stop("length of 'pstart' must be ",npar)
              parameters$mu <- pstart[1]
              parameters$sigma <- pstart[2]
            }
            mod <- new("truncdiscgaus",parameters=parameters,fixed=fixed,x=x,y=y,npar=npar, breaks=breaks, min=min, max=max)
            mod
          }
)

# define a response class which only contains the standard slots, no additional slots
setClass("vtdgaus", contains="response", slots=c(yield="numeric"))

# define a generic for the method defining the response class

setGeneric("vtdgaus", function(y, pstart = NULL, fixed = NULL, ...) standardGeneric("vtdgaus"))

# define the method that creates the response class

setMethod("vtdgaus", 
          signature(y="ANY"), 
          function(y, yield, pstart=NULL,fixed=NULL, ...) {
            y <- matrix(y,length(y))
            x <- matrix(1)
            parameters <- list()
            npar <- 2
            if(is.null(fixed)) fixed <- as.logical(rep(0,npar))
            if(!is.null(pstart)) {
              if(length(pstart)!=npar) stop("length of 'pstart' must be ",npar)
              parameters$mu <- pstart[1]
              parameters$sigma <- pstart[2]
            } else {
              parameters <- list(mu=.5,sigma=1)
            }
            mod <- new("vtdgaus",parameters=parameters,fixed=fixed,x=x,y=y,npar=npar, yield=yield)
            mod
          }
)

setMethod("show","vtdgaus",
  function(object) {
    cat("Gaussian with variable discrete support for percentage responses\n")
    cat("Parameters: \n")
    cat("mu: ", object@parameters$mu, "\n")
    cat("sigma: ", object@parameters$sigma, "\n")
  }
)

setMethod("dens","vtdgaus",
  function(object,log=FALSE) {
      # determine cuts for pnorm based on 
      #p <- pnorm(sapply(object@y + .5*(1/object@yield), function(x) min(x,1.001)), mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma) - pnorm(sapply(object@y - .5*(1/object@yield),function(x) max(x,-0.001)), mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma)
      #norm <- (pnorm(1 + .001, mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma) - pnorm(-0.001, mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma))
      #p <- p/norm
    
      # alternatively, normalize factor based on size of cuts
    
      prec <- pnorm(1 + .5*(1/60), mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma) - pnorm(0 - .5*(1/60), mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma)
      # check for issues with precision, using highest yield
      if(prec < 1e-12) {
        p <- 1/(object@yield + 1)
      } else {
        p <- pnorm(object@y + .5*(1/object@yield), mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma) - pnorm(object@y - .5*(1/object@yield), mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma)
        norm <- pnorm(1 + .5*(1/object@yield), mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma) - pnorm(0 - .5*(1/object@yield), mean = object@parameters$mu, sd = object@parameters$sigma)
        p <- p/norm
      }
      # probability when yield == 0 is always 1 
      p[object@yield == 0] <- 1
      if(log) return(log(p)) else return(p)
    }
)

# ---- vcov() for custom vtdgaus response ----
setMethod("vcov", signature(object = "vtdgaus"),
  function(object) {
    pars_now <- getpars(object)
    if (is.null(names(pars_now))) names(pars_now) <- c("mu", "sigma")
    stopifnot(length(pars_now) == 2)

    u0 <- c(mu = pars_now[1], log_sigma = log(pars_now[2]))

    nll_u <- function(u) {
      mu <- u[1]
      sigma <- exp(u[2])
      obj <- setpars(object, c(mu, sigma))
      dens_vals <- dens(obj)
      -sum(log(pmax(dens_vals, 1e-12)))
    }

    H <- numDeriv::hessian(nll_u, u0)
    Vu <- tryCatch(solve(H), error = function(e) MASS::ginv(H))

    J <- matrix(
      c(1, 0, 0, exp(u0[2])),
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      dimnames = list(c("mu", "sigma"), c("mu", "log_sigma"))
    )
    Vp <- J %*% Vu %*% t(J)
    dimnames(Vp) <- list(c("mu", "sigma"), c("mu", "sigma"))
    Vp
  }
)

          }
)

setMethod("fit","vtdgaus",
          function(object,w) {
            if(missing(w)) w <- NULL
            if(!is.null(w)) {
              negLL <- function(pars) {
                object <- setpars(object, c(pars[1], exp(pars[2])))
                -sum(w*log(dens(object)))
              }
            } else {
              negLL <- function(pars) {
                object <- setpars(object, c(pars[1], exp(pars[2])))
                -sum(log(dens(object)))
              }
            }
            pars <- optim(c(object@parameters$mu, log(object@parameters$sigma)), fn=negLL)$par
            object <- setpars(object,c(pars[1], exp(pars[2])))
            object
          }
)

```{r investor-standardized-search-foundations, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
# The investor and trustee searches use the same fitting effort and validity
# rules. Their response distributions and transition predictors remain
# role-specific.
hmm_standardized_search_settings <- list(
  state_counts = 2:7,
  screen_starts = 20L,
  full_starts = 3L,
  perturbations = 5L,
  screen_iterations = 20L,
  max_iterations = 2000L,
  rescue_rounds = 4L,
  base_seed = 20250708L,
  output_dir = NA_character_
)
investor_search_settings <- hmm_standardized_search_settings
investor_state_count_override <- Sys.getenv(
  "VTC_INVESTOR_HMM_STATE_COUNTS",
  ""
)
if (nzchar(investor_state_count_override)) {
  requested_state_counts <- as.integer(strsplit(
    investor_state_count_override,
    ",",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]])
  stopifnot(
    length(requested_state_counts) >= 1L,
    !anyNA(requested_state_counts),
    !anyDuplicated(requested_state_counts),
    all(requested_state_counts %in%
      hmm_standardized_search_settings$state_counts)
  )
  investor_search_settings$state_counts <- sort(requested_state_counts)
}
investor_hmm_dat <- inv_dat %>%
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("CC", "BPD")) %>%
  droplevels()
stopifnot(
  nrow(investor_hmm_dat) == 4140L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(investor_hmm_dat$subject_ID) == 414L,
  identical(levels(investor_hmm_dat$group), c("CC", "BPD")),
  all(dplyr::count(investor_hmm_dat, subject_ID)$n == 10L)
)

investor_simple_templates <- vector(
  "list", max(investor_search_settings$state_counts)
)
investor_group_templates <- vector(
  "list", max(investor_search_settings$state_counts)
)
investor_prior_data <- investor_hmm_dat %>% dplyr::filter(round == 1L)

for (state_count in investor_search_settings$state_counts) {
  simple_structure <- depmix(
    investment ~ 1,
    data = investor_hmm_dat,
    nstates = state_count,
    transition = ~ invPnL,
    family = gaussian(),
    ntimes = rep(10L, nrow(investor_prior_data))
  )
  group_structure <- depmix(
    investment ~ 1,
    data = investor_hmm_dat,
    nstates = state_count,
    transition = ~ invPnL * BPD_ctrst,
    family = gaussian(),
    ntimes = rep(10L, nrow(investor_prior_data))
  )
  starting_means <- seq_len(state_count) * (20 / (state_count + 1))
  starting_sigmas <- rep(20 / (state_count + 1), state_count)
  response_models <- lapply(seq_len(state_count), function(state) {
    list(truncdiscgaus(
      investor_hmm_dat$investment,
      pstart = c(starting_means[[state]], starting_sigmas[[state]]),
      min = -0.5,
      max = 20.5
    ))
  })
  investor_simple_templates[[state_count]] <- makeDepmix(
    response = response_models,
    transition = simple_structure@transition,
    prior = simple_structure@prior,
    ntimes = rep(10L, nrow(investor_prior_data)),
    homogeneous = FALSE
  )
  investor_group_templates[[state_count]] <- makeDepmix(
    response = response_models,
    transition = group_structure@transition,
    prior = group_structure@prior,
    ntimes = rep(10L, nrow(investor_prior_data)),
    homogeneous = FALSE
  )
}

investor_fit_converged <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(FALSE)
  paste(model@message, collapse = " ") %in% c(
    "Log likelihood converged to within tol. (relative change)",
    "Log likelihood converged to within tol. (absolute change)"
  ) && is.finite(as.numeric(logLik(model)))
}

investor_warm_start <- function(
    simple_fit, group_structure, state_count) {
  original <- getpars(simple_fit)
  simple_prior_covariates <- ncol(simple_fit@prior@x)
  group_prior_covariates <- ncol(group_structure@prior@x)
  simple_transition_covariates <- ncol(simple_fit@transition[[1]]@x)
  group_transition_covariates <-
    ncol(group_structure@transition[[1]]@x)

  prior_end <- state_count * simple_prior_covariates
  stopifnot(
    identical(simple_fit@prior@family$link, "identity"),
    identical(group_structure@prior@family$link, "identity"),
    identical(
      simple_prior_covariates,
      group_prior_covariates
    )
  )
  new_parameters <- original[seq_len(prior_end)]

  for (from_state in seq_len(state_count)) {
    first <- prior_end + 1L +
      (from_state - 1L) * simple_transition_covariates * state_count
    last <- first + simple_transition_covariates * state_count - 1L
    simple_transition <- matrix(
      original[first:last],
      nrow = state_count,
      ncol = simple_transition_covariates
    )
    expanded_transition <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow = state_count,
      ncol = group_transition_covariates
    )
    expanded_transition[, seq_len(simple_transition_covariates)] <-
      simple_transition
    new_parameters <- c(new_parameters, as.numeric(expanded_transition))
  }

  response_first <- prior_end + 1L +
    state_count * simple_transition_covariates * state_count
  new_parameters <- c(
    new_parameters,
    original[response_first:length(original)]
  )
  stopifnot(length(new_parameters) == length(getpars(group_structure)))
  output <- setpars(group_structure, new_parameters)
  nested_start_error <- max(
    abs(simple_fit@init - output@init),
    abs(simple_fit@trDens - output@trDens),
    abs(simple_fit@dens - output@dens)
  )
  if (!is.finite(nested_start_error) || nested_start_error > 1e-12) {
    stop("Investor group warm start does not reproduce the simple model")
  }
  output
}

investor_perturb_start <- function(model, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  state_count <- nstates(model)
  prior_parameters <- getpars(model@prior)
  prior_fixed <- getpars(model@prior, which = "fixed")
  prior_parameters[!prior_fixed] <- prior_parameters[!prior_fixed] +
    rnorm(sum(!prior_fixed), sd = 0.02)
  complete_parameters <- prior_parameters

  for (state in seq_len(state_count)) {
    transition_parameters <- getpars(model@transition[[state]])
    transition_fixed <- getpars(
      model@transition[[state]], which = "fixed"
    )
    transition_parameters[!transition_fixed] <-
      transition_parameters[!transition_fixed] +
      rnorm(sum(!transition_fixed), sd = 0.02)
    complete_parameters <- c(complete_parameters, transition_parameters)
  }
  for (state in seq_len(state_count)) {
    response_parameters <- getpars(model@response[[state]][[1]])
    response_parameters[[1]] <- response_parameters[[1]] +
      rnorm(1, sd = 0.1)
    response_parameters[[2]] <- response_parameters[[2]] *
      exp(rnorm(1, sd = 0.02))
    complete_parameters <- c(complete_parameters, response_parameters)
  }
  stopifnot(length(complete_parameters) == length(getpars(model)))
  output <- setpars(model, complete_parameters)
  cache_error <- max(
    abs(output@init - dens(output@prior)),
    max(vapply(seq_len(state_count), function(state) {
      max(abs(
        output@trDens[, , state] - dens(output@transition[[state]])
      ))
    }, numeric(1))),
    max(vapply(seq_len(state_count), function(state) {
      max(abs(
        output@dens[, 1, state] - dens(output@response[[state]][[1]])
      ))
    }, numeric(1)))
  )
  if (!is.finite(cache_error) || cache_error > 1e-12) {
    stop("Perturbed investor HMM probability-cache mismatch: ", cache_error)
  }
  output
}

```{r investor-standardized-search-functions, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
investor_fit_route <- function(
    model, state_count, family, label, seed, iterations,
    package_random_start = FALSE, parent = NA_character_) {
  set.seed(seed)
  warnings_seen <- character()
  fitted <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      fit(
        model,
        emcontrol = em.control(
          maxit = iterations,
          tol = 1e-8,
          crit = "relative",
          random.start = package_random_start
        )
      ),
      warning = function(condition) {
        warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(condition))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(condition) condition
  )
  error_message <- if (inherits(fitted, "error")) {
    conditionMessage(fitted)
  } else {
    ""
  }
  if (inherits(fitted, "error")) fitted <- NULL
  likelihood <- if (is.null(fitted)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(logLik(fitted))
  message(
    "Investor K=", state_count,
    " family=", family,
    " route=", label,
    " converged=", investor_fit_converged(fitted),
    " logLik=", ifelse(is.finite(likelihood), round(likelihood, 4), "NA")
  )
  list(
    model = fitted,
    log = tibble::tibble(
      state_count = state_count,
      family = family,
      label = label,
      parent = parent,
      seed = seed,
      iterations = iterations,
      initialization = if (package_random_start) {
        "depmixS4_random_gamma_emission_refit"
      } else {
        "provided_parameter_start"
      },
      converged = investor_fit_converged(fitted),
      log_likelihood = likelihood,
      warnings = paste(unique(warnings_seen), collapse = " | "),
      error = error_message
    )
  )
}

investor_membership_search <- function(
    template, state_count, family, seed_offset) {
  screens <- lapply(
    seq_len(investor_search_settings$screen_starts),
    function(start_id) {
      investor_fit_route(
        template,
        state_count,
        family,
        paste0(family, "_membership_screen_", sprintf("%02d", start_id)),
        investor_search_settings$base_seed + state_count * 100000L +
          seed_offset + start_id,
        investor_search_settings$screen_iterations,
        package_random_start = TRUE
      )
    }
  )
  successful <- which(vapply(
    screens, function(item) !is.null(item$model), logical(1)
  ))
  if (length(successful) < investor_search_settings$full_starts) {
    stop("Too few successful investor membership screens for K=", state_count)
  }
  likelihoods <- vapply(
    screens[successful],
    function(item) as.numeric(logLik(item$model)),
    numeric(1)
  )
  chosen <- successful[order(likelihoods, decreasing = TRUE)[
    seq_len(investor_search_settings$full_starts)
  ]]
  promoted <- lapply(
    seq_len(investor_search_settings$full_starts),
    function(rank) {
      screen_id <- chosen[[rank]]
      investor_fit_route(
        screens[[screen_id]]$model,
        state_count,
        family,
        paste0(
          family, "_membership_full_", sprintf("%02d", rank),
          "_screen_", sprintf("%02d", screen_id)
        ),
        investor_search_settings$base_seed + state_count * 100000L +
          seed_offset + 1000L + rank,
        investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
        parent = screens[[screen_id]]$log$label[[1]]
      )
    }
  )
  list(
    candidates = promoted,
    logs = dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(screens, `[[`, "log"),
      lapply(promoted, `[[`, "log")
    )
  )
}

investor_candidate_diagnostics <- function(model) {
  if (!investor_fit_converged(model)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      valid = FALSE,
      minimum_occupancy = NA_real_,
      minimum_sigma = NA_real_,
      maximum_absolute_transition_parameter = NA_real_,
      reason = "nonconverged"
    ))
  }
  ordered <- order_mod_truncdiscgaus(model)
  occupancy <- colMeans(
    forwardbackward(ordered, return.all = TRUE)$gamma
  )
  sigmas <- vapply(seq_len(nstates(ordered)), function(state) {
    unname(getpars(ordered@response[[state]][[1]])[[2]])
  }, numeric(1))
  transition_parameters <- unlist(lapply(ordered@transition, getpars))
  finite <- all(is.finite(c(
    occupancy, sigmas, transition_parameters, getpars(ordered)
  )))
  valid <- finite && min(occupancy) >= 0.005 && min(sigmas) > 1e-6
  tibble::tibble(
    valid = valid,
    minimum_occupancy = min(occupancy),
    minimum_sigma = min(sigmas),
    maximum_absolute_transition_parameter =
      max(abs(transition_parameters)),
    reason = if (valid) {
      "valid"
    } else if (!finite) {
      "nonfinite"
    } else {
      "degenerate"
    }
  )
}

investor_select_candidate <- function(candidates, state_count, family) {
  comparison <- purrr::map_dfr(candidates, function(item) {
    dplyr::bind_cols(item$log, investor_candidate_diagnostics(item$model))
  })
  valid_rows <- which(comparison$valid)
  if (!length(valid_rows)) {
    stop("No valid investor ", family, " candidate for K=", state_count)
  }
  best_row <- valid_rows[[which.max(
    comparison$log_likelihood[valid_rows]
  )]]
  best_label <- comparison$label[[best_row]]
  best_item <- candidates[[which(vapply(
    candidates,
    function(item) identical(item$log$label[[1]], best_label),
    logical(1)
  ))]]
  list(
    model = best_item$model,
    ordered_model = order_mod_truncdiscgaus(best_item$model),
    label = best_label,
    comparison = comparison %>%
      dplyr::mutate(selected = label == best_label) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(valid), dplyr::desc(log_likelihood))
  )
}

investor_rescue_candidates <- function(candidates, state_count, family) {
  candidate_is_valid <- function(item) {
    isTRUE(investor_candidate_diagnostics(item$model)$valid[[1]])
  }
  if (any(vapply(candidates, candidate_is_valid, logical(1)))) {
    return(candidates)
  }
  active <- purrr::keep(candidates, function(item) {
    !is.null(item$model) && is.finite(as.numeric(logLik(item$model)))
  })
  if (!length(active)) return(candidates)
  active <- active[order(
    vapply(active, function(item) as.numeric(logLik(item$model)), numeric(1)),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )]
  rescue_width <- if (family == "simple") {
    length(active)
  } else {
    investor_search_settings$full_starts
  }
  active <- utils::head(active, rescue_width)

  for (round_id in seq_len(investor_search_settings$rescue_rounds)) {
    rescued <- lapply(seq_along(active), function(rank) {
      parent_label <- active[[rank]]$log$label[[1]]
      investor_fit_route(
        active[[rank]]$model,
        state_count,
        family,
        paste0(
          family, "_rescue_round_", sprintf("%02d", round_id),
          "_rank_", sprintf("%02d", rank)
        ),
        investor_search_settings$base_seed + state_count * 100000L +
          ifelse(family == "simple", 80000L, 90000L) +
          round_id * 100L + rank,
        investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
        parent = parent_label
      )
    })
    candidates <- c(candidates, rescued)
    if (any(vapply(rescued, candidate_is_valid, logical(1)))) {
      return(candidates)
    }
    active <- purrr::keep(rescued, function(item) !is.null(item$model))
    if (!length(active)) return(candidates)
  }
  candidates
}

investor_search_state_count <- function(state_count) {
  message("Starting standardized investor search for K=", state_count)
  simple_membership <- investor_membership_search(
    investor_simple_templates[[state_count]],
    state_count,
    "simple",
    10000L
  )
  simple_direct <- investor_fit_route(
    investor_simple_templates[[state_count]],
    state_count,
    "simple",
    "simple_structured_direct",
    investor_search_settings$base_seed,
    investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
    parent = "simple_structured_template"
  )
  simple_candidates <- investor_rescue_candidates(
    c(simple_membership$candidates, list(simple_direct)),
    state_count,
    "simple"
  )
  best_simple <- investor_select_candidate(
    simple_candidates, state_count, "simple"
  )

  group_membership <- investor_membership_search(
    investor_group_templates[[state_count]],
    state_count,
    "group",
    50000L
  )
  group_direct <- investor_fit_route(
    investor_group_templates[[state_count]],
    state_count,
    "group",
    "group_structured_direct",
    investor_search_settings$base_seed,
    investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
    parent = "group_structured_template"
  )
  best_simple_warm_start <- investor_warm_start(
    best_simple$model,
    investor_group_templates[[state_count]],
    state_count
  )
  group_best_simple_warm <- investor_fit_route(
    best_simple_warm_start,
    state_count,
    "group",
    "group_best_simple_warm",
    investor_search_settings$base_seed,
    investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
    parent = best_simple$label
  )
  if (investor_fit_converged(simple_direct$model)) {
    structured_warm_start <- investor_warm_start(
      simple_direct$model,
      investor_group_templates[[state_count]],
      state_count
    )
    group_structured_warm <- investor_fit_route(
      structured_warm_start,
      state_count,
      "group",
      "group_structured_warm",
      investor_search_settings$base_seed,
      investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
      parent = "simple_structured_direct"
    )
    perturbation_warm_start <- structured_warm_start
    perturbation_warm_parent <- "group_structured_warm_start"
  } else {
    group_structured_warm <- list(
      model = NULL,
      log = tibble::tibble(
        state_count = state_count,
        family = "group",
        label = "group_structured_warm",
        parent = "simple_structured_direct",
        seed = investor_search_settings$base_seed,
        iterations = investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
        initialization = "unavailable_nonconverged_parent",
        converged = FALSE,
        log_likelihood = NA_real_,
        warnings = "",
        error = "Structured simple parent did not converge"
      )
    )
    perturbation_warm_start <- best_simple_warm_start
    perturbation_warm_parent <- "group_best_simple_warm_start"
  }

  perturbations <- unlist(lapply(c("direct", "warm"), function(route) {
    base_model <- if (route == "direct") {
      investor_group_templates[[state_count]]
    } else {
      perturbation_warm_start
    }
    parent_label <- if (route == "direct") {
      "group_structured_direct_start"
    } else {
      perturbation_warm_parent
    }
    route_offset <- if (route == "direct") 1000L else 2000L
    lapply(seq_len(investor_search_settings$perturbations), function(index) {
      perturbation_seed <- investor_search_settings$base_seed +
        route_offset + index
      label <- paste0(
        "group_perturbed_", route, "_", sprintf("%02d", index)
      )
      perturbed <- tryCatch(
        investor_perturb_start(base_model, perturbation_seed),
        error = function(condition) condition
      )
      if (inherits(perturbed, "error")) {
        list(
          model = NULL,
          log = tibble::tibble(
            state_count = state_count,
            family = "group",
            label = label,
            parent = parent_label,
            seed = perturbation_seed,
            iterations = investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
            initialization = "provided_parameter_start",
            converged = FALSE,
            log_likelihood = NA_real_,
            warnings = "",
            error = conditionMessage(perturbed)
          )
        )
      } else {
        investor_fit_route(
          perturbed,
          state_count,
          "group",
          label,
          perturbation_seed,
          investor_search_settings$max_iterations,
          parent = parent_label
        )
      }
    })
  }), recursive = FALSE)

  group_candidates <- investor_rescue_candidates(
    c(
      group_membership$candidates,
      list(group_direct, group_structured_warm, group_best_simple_warm),
      perturbations
    ),
    state_count,
    "group"
  )
  best_group <- investor_select_candidate(
    group_candidates,
    state_count,
    "group"
  )
  message(
    "Finished standardized investor search for K=", state_count,
    ": simple=", round(as.numeric(logLik(best_simple$model)), 4),
    ", group=", round(as.numeric(logLik(best_group$model)), 4)
  )
  list(
    simple = best_simple,
    group = best_group,
    screen_logs = dplyr::bind_rows(
      simple_membership$logs,
      group_membership$logs
    )
  )
}
