```{r investor-standardized-search-run, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
investor_summarise_search <- function(state_results) {
  model_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(state_results, function(result, state_name) {
    purrr::map_dfr(c("simple", "group"), function(family) {
      selected <- result[[family]]
      likelihood <- as.numeric(logLik(selected$model))
      parameters <- as.integer(attr(logLik(selected$model), "df"))
      diagnostics <- investor_candidate_diagnostics(selected$model)
      tibble::tibble(
        state_count = as.integer(state_name),
        family = family,
        selected_label = selected$label,
        log_likelihood = likelihood,
        parameters = parameters,
        AIC = -2 * likelihood + 2 * parameters,
        BIC_trials = -2 * likelihood +
          parameters * log(nrow(investor_hmm_dat)),
        BIC_sequences = -2 * likelihood +
          parameters * log(nrow(investor_prior_data)),
        valid_candidates = sum(selected$comparison$valid),
        converged_candidates = sum(selected$comparison$converged),
        near_best_candidates = sum(
          selected$comparison$valid &
            selected$comparison$log_likelihood >= likelihood - 1
        ),
        minimum_occupancy = diagnostics$minimum_occupancy,
        minimum_sigma = diagnostics$minimum_sigma
      )
    })
  })
  nested_tests <- purrr::imap_dfr(state_results, function(result, state_name) {
    statistic <- 2 * (
      as.numeric(logLik(result$group$model)) -
        as.numeric(logLik(result$simple$model))
    )
    if (statistic < -1e-6) {
      stop("Investor nested-model likelihood ordering failed for K=", state_name)
    }
    statistic <- max(0, statistic)
    degrees_of_freedom <-
      attr(logLik(result$group$model), "df") -
      attr(logLik(result$simple$model), "df")
    tibble::tibble(
      state_count = as.integer(state_name),
      group_log_likelihood = as.numeric(logLik(result$group$model)),
      simple_log_likelihood = as.numeric(logLik(result$simple$model)),
      statistic = statistic,
      degrees_of_freedom = degrees_of_freedom,
      p_value = stats::pchisq(
        statistic,
        degrees_of_freedom,
        lower.tail = FALSE
      )
    )
  })
  criteria <- c("AIC", "BIC_trials", "BIC_sequences")
  within_family <- purrr::map_dfr(c("simple", "group"), function(family) {
    family_table <- model_table %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$family == .env$family)
    purrr::map_dfr(criteria, function(criterion) {
      selected_row <- which.min(family_table[[criterion]])
      tibble::tibble(
        selection_scope = paste0("within_", family),
        criterion = criterion,
        selected_state_count = family_table$state_count[[selected_row]],
        selected_family = family,
        selected_value = family_table[[criterion]][[selected_row]]
      )
    })
  })
  overall <- purrr::map_dfr(criteria, function(criterion) {
    selected_row <- which.min(model_table[[criterion]])
    tibble::tibble(
      selection_scope = "overall",
      criterion = criterion,
      selected_state_count = model_table$state_count[[selected_row]],
      selected_family = model_table$family[[selected_row]],
      selected_value = model_table[[criterion]][[selected_row]]
    )
  })
  group_selection <- within_family %>%
    dplyr::filter(selection_scope == "within_group") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      nested_tests,
      by = c("selected_state_count" = "state_count")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      criterion,
      group_family_state_count = selected_state_count,
      likelihood_ratio = statistic,
      degrees_of_freedom,
      p_value,
      retain_group_terms = p_value < 0.05
    )
  list(
    model_comparison = model_table,
    nested_lrt = nested_tests,
    selection_summary = dplyr::bind_rows(within_family, overall),
    two_stage_summary = group_selection
  )
}

investor_chunk_sha256 <- function(label) {
  source_lines <- readLines("analysis_main.Rmd", warn = FALSE)
  start <- grep(
    paste0("```{r ", label, ","),
    source_lines,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
  if (length(start) != 1L) stop("Could not locate R chunk: ", label)
  finish <- start + which(source_lines[(start + 1L):length(source_lines)] ==
    "```")[[1]]
  digest::digest(
    paste(source_lines[(start + 1L):(finish - 1L)], collapse = "\n"),
    algo = "sha256",
    serialize = FALSE
  )
}

investor_search_signature <- function() {
  list(
    config = investor_search_settings,
    R_version = R.version.string,
    platform = R.version$platform,
    depmixS4_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("depmixS4")),
    behavioral_data_sha256 = digest::digest(
      file = file.path("Data", "full_RTG_data.csv"),
      algo = "sha256"
    ),
    analysis_data_sha256 = digest::digest(
      investor_hmm_dat,
      algo = "sha256"
    ),
    helper_sha256 = digest::digest(
      file = file.path("scripts", "hmm_cache_utils.R"),
      algo = "sha256"
    ),
    foundations_chunk_sha256 = investor_chunk_sha256(
      "investor-standardized-search-foundations"
    ),
    functions_chunk_sha256 = investor_chunk_sha256(
      "investor-standardized-search-functions"
    ),
    run_chunk_sha256 = investor_chunk_sha256(
      "investor-standardized-search-run"
    )
  )
}

investor_write_progress <- function(
    path, current, total, state_count, status) {
  if (!nzchar(path)) return(invisible(NULL))
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  jsonlite::write_json(
    list(
      current = as.integer(current),
      total = as.integer(total),
      state_count = as.integer(state_count),
      status = status,
      updated_at = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE)
    ),
    path,
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    pretty = TRUE
  )
}

investor_write_search_artifacts <- function(
    state_results, output_dir, started_at, run_signature) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  summary <- investor_summarise_search(state_results)
  candidate_fit_log <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    state_results,
    function(result, state_name) {
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        result$screen_logs %>%
          dplyr::filter(grepl("_membership_screen_", label)) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(candidate_stage = "screen"),
        result$simple$comparison %>%
          dplyr::mutate(candidate_stage = "full_candidate"),
        result$group$comparison %>%
          dplyr::mutate(candidate_stage = "full_candidate")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state_count = as.integer(state_name), .before = 1)
    }
  )
  expected_candidates_per_state <-
    2L * investor_search_settings$screen_starts +
    (investor_search_settings$full_starts + 1L) +
    (investor_search_settings$full_starts + 3L +
       2L * investor_search_settings$perturbations)
  stopifnot(
    nrow(candidate_fit_log) >=
      length(state_results) * expected_candidates_per_state,
    !anyDuplicated(candidate_fit_log[c("state_count", "label")])
  )
  selected_models <- purrr::map(state_results, function(result) {
    list(
      simple = result$simple$model,
      group = result$group$model,
      ordered_simple = result$simple$ordered_model,
      ordered_group = result$group$ordered_model,
      simple_label = result$simple$label,
      group_label = result$group$label
    )
  })
  result <- list(
    config = run_signature$config,
    model_comparison = summary$model_comparison,
    nested_lrt = summary$nested_lrt,
    selection_summary = summary$selection_summary,
    two_stage_summary = summary$two_stage_summary,
    selected_models = selected_models,
    candidate_fit_log = candidate_fit_log,
    generated_at = Sys.time()
  )
  result_path <- file.path(output_dir, "standardized_search_result.rds")
  saveRDS(result, result_path, compress = "xz")
  readr::write_csv(
    summary$model_comparison,
    file.path(output_dir, "model_comparison.csv")
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    summary$nested_lrt,
    file.path(output_dir, "nested_lrt.csv")
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    summary$selection_summary,
    file.path(output_dir, "selection_summary.csv")
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    summary$two_stage_summary,
    file.path(output_dir, "two_stage_summary.csv")
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    candidate_fit_log,
    file.path(output_dir, "candidate_fit_log.csv")
  )
  manifest <- tibble::tibble(
    field = c(
      "started_utc", "completed_utc", "R_version", "platform",
      "depmixS4_version", "behavioral_data_sha256", "helper_sha256",
      "analysis_data_sha256",
      "foundations_chunk_sha256", "functions_chunk_sha256",
      "run_chunk_sha256", "state_counts", "screen_starts",
      "full_starts", "perturbations", "screen_iterations",
      "max_iterations", "rescue_rounds", "base_seed", "participant_sequences",
      "trials", "run_signature_sha256"
    ),
    value = c(
      format(started_at, tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      R.version.string,
      R.version$platform,
      as.character(utils::packageVersion("depmixS4")),
      run_signature$behavioral_data_sha256,
      run_signature$helper_sha256,
      run_signature$analysis_data_sha256,
      run_signature$foundations_chunk_sha256,
      run_signature$functions_chunk_sha256,
      run_signature$run_chunk_sha256,
      paste(run_signature$config$state_counts, collapse = ","),
      as.character(run_signature$config$screen_starts),
      as.character(run_signature$config$full_starts),
      as.character(run_signature$config$perturbations),
      as.character(run_signature$config$screen_iterations),
      as.character(run_signature$config$max_iterations),
      as.character(run_signature$config$rescue_rounds),
      as.character(run_signature$config$base_seed),
      as.character(nrow(investor_prior_data)),
      as.character(nrow(investor_hmm_dat)),
      digest::digest(run_signature, algo = "sha256")
    )
  )
  readr::write_csv(manifest, file.path(output_dir, "RUN_MANIFEST.csv"))
  stable_artifact_names <- c(
    "standardized_search_result.rds",
    "model_comparison.csv",
    "nested_lrt.csv",
    "selection_summary.csv",
    "two_stage_summary.csv",
    "candidate_fit_log.csv",
    "RUN_MANIFEST.csv"
  )
  artifact_files <- file.path(output_dir, stable_artifact_names)
  if (!all(file.exists(artifact_files))) {
    stop("One or more final investor-search artifacts are missing")
  }
  artifact_hash_index <- tibble::tibble(
    relative_path = basename(artifact_files),
    bytes = file.info(artifact_files)$size,
    sha256 = vapply(
      artifact_files,
      digest::digest,
      character(1),
      file = TRUE,
      algo = "sha256"
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(relative_path)
  readr::write_csv(
    artifact_hash_index,
    file.path(output_dir, "artifact_hash_index.csv")
  )
  result
}

investor_full_recompute <- identical(
  Sys.getenv("VTC_INVESTOR_HMM_FULL_RECOMPUTE"), "1"
) || identical(Sys.getenv("VTC_HMM_FULL_RECOMPUTE"), "1")
investor_parallel_merge <- identical(
  Sys.getenv("VTC_INVESTOR_HMM_PARALLEL_MERGE"), "1"
)

if (investor_full_recompute) {
  investor_search_output_dir <- Sys.getenv(
    "VTC_INVESTOR_HMM_OUTPUT_DIR",
    file.path(
      "results", "HMM", "recomputed_from_analysis_main",
      "standardized_investor_search_v1"
    )
  )
  investor_progress_path <- Sys.getenv(
    "VTC_INVESTOR_HMM_PROGRESS",
    file.path(investor_search_output_dir, "progress.json")
  )
  investor_checkpoint_path <- file.path(
    investor_search_output_dir,
    "partial_state_results.rds"
  )
  dir.create(
    investor_search_output_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  investor_started_at <- Sys.time()
  investor_run_signature <- investor_search_signature()
  investor_state_results <- list()
  if (identical(Sys.getenv("VTC_INVESTOR_HMM_RESUME"), "1") &&
      file.exists(investor_checkpoint_path)) {
    investor_checkpoint <- readRDS(investor_checkpoint_path)
    stopifnot(
      setequal(
        names(investor_checkpoint),
        c("signature", "state_results", "started_at", "updated_at")
      ),
      identical(investor_checkpoint$signature, investor_run_signature)
    )
    investor_state_results <- investor_checkpoint$state_results
    investor_started_at <- investor_checkpoint$started_at
  }
  total_states <- length(investor_search_settings$state_counts)
  completed_state_keys <- names(investor_state_results)
  if (is.null(completed_state_keys)) completed_state_keys <- character()
  expected_completed_keys <- as.character(
    utils::head(
      investor_search_settings$state_counts,
      length(completed_state_keys)
    )
  )
  if (!identical(completed_state_keys, expected_completed_keys)) {
    stop("Investor checkpoint does not contain the expected state sequence")
  }
  investor_write_progress(
    investor_progress_path,
    length(investor_state_results),
    total_states,
    if (length(investor_state_results)) {
      max(as.integer(names(investor_state_results)))
    } else {
      0L
    },
    "running"
  )
  for (state_count in investor_search_settings$state_counts) {
    state_name <- as.character(state_count)
    if (state_name %in% names(investor_state_results)) next
    investor_state_results[[state_name]] <-
      investor_search_state_count(state_count)
    saveRDS(
      list(
        signature = investor_run_signature,
        state_results = investor_state_results,
        started_at = investor_started_at,
        updated_at = Sys.time()
      ),
      investor_checkpoint_path,
      compress = "xz"
    )
    investor_write_progress(
      investor_progress_path,
      length(investor_state_results),
      total_states,
      state_count,
      "running"
    )
  }
  if (!identical(investor_search_signature(), investor_run_signature)) {
    stop("Investor search code, settings, helper, or data changed during fitting")
  }
  if (!identical(
    names(investor_state_results),
    as.character(investor_search_settings$state_counts)
  )) {
    stop("Investor search did not complete the exact requested state sequence")
  }
  investor_standardized_search_result <-
    investor_write_search_artifacts(
      investor_state_results,
      investor_search_output_dir,
      investor_started_at,
      investor_run_signature
    )
  investor_write_progress(
    investor_progress_path,
    total_states,
    total_states,
    max(investor_search_settings$state_counts),
    "complete"
  )
}

if (investor_parallel_merge) {
  investor_parallel_source_dirs <- strsplit(
    Sys.getenv("VTC_INVESTOR_HMM_PARALLEL_DIRS"),
    ",",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]
  investor_parallel_source_dirs <-
    investor_parallel_source_dirs[nzchar(investor_parallel_source_dirs)]
  expected_state_counts <-
    hmm_standardized_search_settings$state_counts
  stopifnot(
    length(investor_parallel_source_dirs) ==
      length(expected_state_counts)
  )

  expected_merged_signature <- investor_search_signature()
  parallel_checkpoints <- lapply(
    investor_parallel_source_dirs,
    function(source_dir) {
      checkpoint_path <- file.path(
        source_dir,
        "partial_state_results.rds"
      )
      if (!file.exists(checkpoint_path)) {
        stop("Missing parallel investor checkpoint: ", checkpoint_path)
      }
      readRDS(checkpoint_path)
    }
  )

  investor_state_results <- list()
  for (state_count in expected_state_counts) {
    matching_checkpoint <- which(vapply(
      parallel_checkpoints,
      function(checkpoint) {
        identical(
          checkpoint$signature$config$state_counts,
          as.integer(state_count)
        )
      },
      logical(1)
    ))
    if (length(matching_checkpoint) != 1L) {
      stop(
        "Expected exactly one parallel checkpoint for K=",
        state_count
      )
    }
    checkpoint <- parallel_checkpoints[[matching_checkpoint]]
    expected_state_signature <- expected_merged_signature
    expected_state_signature$config$state_counts <-
      as.integer(state_count)
    stopifnot(
      setequal(
        names(checkpoint),
        c("signature", "state_results", "started_at", "updated_at")
      ),
      identical(checkpoint$signature, expected_state_signature),
      identical(names(checkpoint$state_results), as.character(state_count))
    )
    investor_state_results[[as.character(state_count)]] <-
      checkpoint$state_results[[as.character(state_count)]]
  }

  investor_search_output_dir <- Sys.getenv(
    "VTC_INVESTOR_HMM_OUTPUT_DIR",
    file.path(
      "results", "HMM", "recomputed_from_analysis_main",
      "standardized_investor_parallel_merged_v1"
    )
  )
  investor_started_at <- min(vapply(
    parallel_checkpoints,
    function(checkpoint) as.numeric(checkpoint$started_at),
    numeric(1)
  ))
  investor_started_at <- as.POSIXct(
    investor_started_at,
    origin = "1970-01-01",
    tz = "UTC"
  )
  investor_standardized_search_result <-
    investor_write_search_artifacts(
      investor_state_results,
      investor_search_output_dir,
      investor_started_at,
      expected_merged_signature
    )
  saveRDS(
    list(
      signature = expected_merged_signature,
      state_results = investor_state_results,
      started_at = investor_started_at,
      updated_at = Sys.time()
    ),
    file.path(investor_search_output_dir, "partial_state_results.rds"),
    compress = "xz"
  )
}

investor_reuse_merge <- identical(

if (investor_reuse_merge) {

  )

  reused_checkpoint <- readRDS(investor_reused_checkpoint_path)
  reused_expected_signature <- expected_merged_signature
  reused_expected_signature$foundations_chunk_sha256 <-
    "6795aa17fb1bccf18d658fac50f1ec6e0727e20885c6869c4bf76fdc3036c517"
  reused_expected_signature$run_chunk_sha256 <-
    "03566f0dbc01e72c47eab878caeaac3b4d1f9d82455dc6bfea34c50b0495112d"
  stopifnot(
    setequal(
      names(reused_checkpoint),

    ),
    identical(reused_checkpoint$signature, reused_expected_signature),
    identical(names(reused_checkpoint$state_results), c("2", "3")),
    identical(
      reused_checkpoint$signature$functions_chunk_sha256,
      expected_merged_signature$functions_chunk_sha256
    ),
    identical(
      reused_checkpoint$signature$analysis_data_sha256,

    )
  )

  new_checkpoint_paths <- file.path(
    investor_new_checkpoint_dirs,

  )
  if (!all(file.exists(new_checkpoint_paths))) {

        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }
  new_checkpoints <- lapply(new_checkpoint_paths, readRDS)

  investor_state_results <- reused_checkpoint$state_results
  for (state_count in 4:7) {

    if (length(matching_checkpoint) != 1L) {
      stop(

        state_count
      )
    }
    checkpoint <- new_checkpoints[[matching_checkpoint]]
    expected_state_signature <- expected_merged_signature
    expected_state_signature$config$state_counts <-
      as.integer(state_count)
    stopifnot(
      setequal(
        names(checkpoint),
        c("signature", "state_results", "started_at", "updated_at")
      ),
      identical(checkpoint$signature, expected_state_signature),
      identical(names(checkpoint$state_results), as.character(state_count))
    )
    investor_state_results[[as.character(state_count)]] <-

  stopifnot(identical(names(investor_state_results), as.character(2:7)))
  for (state_count in 2:7) {

    stopifnot(
      investor_fit_converged(state_result$simple$model),

        )$valid[[1]]
      ),
      isTRUE(
        investor_candidate_diagnostics(
          state_result$group$model
        )$valid[[1]]
      )
    )
  }

  investor_started_at <- min(c(

      new_checkpoints,
      function(checkpoint) as.numeric(checkpoint$started_at),

    )
  ))
  investor_started_at <- as.POSIXct(
    investor_started_at,
    origin = "1970-01-01",

  )
  investor_standardized_search_result <-

      investor_state_results,

    )
  investor_merged_checkpoint_path <- file.path(
    investor_search_output_dir,
    "partial_state_results.rds"
  )
  saveRDS(
    list(
      signature = expected_merged_signature,
      state_results = investor_state_results,
      started_at = investor_started_at,
      updated_at = Sys.time()
    ),
    investor_merged_checkpoint_path,
    compress = "xz"
  )

  new_checkpoint_order <- order(vapply(
    new_checkpoints,
    function(checkpoint) checkpoint$signature$config$state_counts,
    integer(1)
  ))
  source_paths <- c(
    rep(investor_reused_checkpoint_path, 2L),
    new_checkpoint_paths[new_checkpoint_order]
  )
  source_state_counts <- 2:7
  source_checkpoints <- c(
    rep(list(reused_checkpoint), 2L),
    new_checkpoints[new_checkpoint_order]
  )
  investor_source_provenance <- tibble::tibble(
    state_count = source_state_counts,
    source = c(
      "completed_sequential_checkpoint",
      "completed_sequential_checkpoint",
      rep("completed_parallel_checkpoint", 4L)
    ),
    checkpoint_path = source_paths,
    checkpoint_sha256 = vapply(
      source_paths,
      digest::digest,
      character(1),
      file = TRUE,
      algo = "sha256"
    ),
    source_signature_sha256 = vapply(
      source_checkpoints,
      function(checkpoint) {
        digest::digest(checkpoint$signature, algo = "sha256")
      },
      character(1)
    ),
    simple_parameter_sha256 = vapply(
      source_state_counts,
      function(state_count) {
        digest::digest(
          getpars(
            investor_state_results[[as.character(state_count)]]$simple$model
          ),
          algo = "sha256"
        )
      },
      character(1)
    ),
    group_parameter_sha256 = vapply(
      source_state_counts,
      function(state_count) {
        digest::digest(
          getpars(
            investor_state_results[[as.character(state_count)]]$group$model
          ),
          algo = "sha256"
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    investor_source_provenance,
    file.path(investor_search_output_dir, "merge_provenance.csv")
  )
}

if (!investor_full_recompute &&
    !investor_parallel_merge &&
    !investor_reuse_merge) {
  investor_cache_dir <- file.path(
    "results", "HMM", "corrected_submission",
    "standardized_investor_cc_bpd_merged_2026-07-28_v1"
  )
  investor_cache_file_names <- c(
    manifest = "RUN_MANIFEST.csv",
    index = "artifact_hash_index.csv",
    result = "standardized_search_result.rds",
    checkpoint = "partial_state_results.rds",
    provenance = "merge_provenance.csv"
  )
  investor_cache_paths <- setNames(
    file.path(investor_cache_dir, investor_cache_file_names),
    names(investor_cache_file_names)
  )
  investor_expected_cache_hashes <- c(
    manifest = "cd7f9e2e6cc411344897428a601dcff853542d5565ac20f95b3c768b4ee35553",
    index = "80d495b510388de870103f61c1ab0eb1fe659cd3a630f2d3cdbe30838655ce95",
    result = "a82d7b4317e96630bbffa1bd7d135dff5d25377b442dccd52200acf6d4e2b95b",
    checkpoint = "53c42143576b9d68746604c27d7d22df5bbe3a526e36d5fd9e34c7556ce690ad",
    provenance = "84742f6b9e3392a361b2dde69215c581f7ba7e959dd6bd4272dd0a1f4eab52a1"
  )
  stopifnot(
    all(file.exists(investor_cache_paths)),
    identical(
      unname(vapply(
        investor_cache_paths,
        digest::digest,
        character(1),
        file = TRUE,
        algo = "sha256"
      )),
      unname(investor_expected_cache_hashes)
    )
  )

  investor_cache_manifest <- readr::read_csv(
    investor_cache_paths[["manifest"]], show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(investor_cache_manifest$field))
  investor_cache_manifest_values <- setNames(
    investor_cache_manifest$value,
    investor_cache_manifest$field
  )
  investor_cache_index <- readr::read_csv(
    investor_cache_paths[["index"]], show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  stopifnot(
    !anyDuplicated(investor_cache_index$relative_path),
    all(file.exists(file.path(
      investor_cache_dir, investor_cache_index$relative_path
    ))),
    all(vapply(seq_len(nrow(investor_cache_index)), function(row) {
      identical(
        digest::digest(
          file = file.path(
            investor_cache_dir,
            investor_cache_index$relative_path[[row]]
          ),
          algo = "sha256"
        ),
        investor_cache_index$sha256[[row]]
      )
    }, logical(1)))
  )

  investor_cache_checkpoint <- readRDS(
    investor_cache_paths[["checkpoint"]]
  )
  stopifnot(
    setequal(
      names(investor_cache_checkpoint),
      c("signature", "state_results", "started_at", "updated_at")
    ),
    identical(
      names(investor_cache_checkpoint$state_results),
      as.character(investor_search_settings$state_counts)
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$config,
      investor_search_settings
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$R_version,
      R.version.string
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$platform,
      R.version$platform
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$depmixS4_version,
      as.character(utils::packageVersion("depmixS4"))
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$behavioral_data_sha256,
      digest::digest(
        file = file.path("Data", "full_RTG_data.csv"), algo = "sha256"
      )
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$helper_sha256,
      digest::digest(
        file = file.path("scripts", "hmm_cache_utils.R"), algo = "sha256"
      )
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$analysis_data_sha256,
      digest::digest(investor_hmm_dat, algo = "sha256")
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$foundations_chunk_sha256,
      investor_chunk_sha256("investor-standardized-search-foundations")
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$functions_chunk_sha256,
      investor_chunk_sha256("investor-standardized-search-functions")
    ),
    identical(
      investor_cache_checkpoint$signature$run_chunk_sha256,
      investor_chunk_sha256("investor-standardized-search-run")
    )
  )

  investor_cached_result <- readRDS(investor_cache_paths[["result"]])
  investor_recomputed_summary <- investor_summarise_search(
    investor_cache_checkpoint$state_results
  )
  investor_model_comparison_check <- all.equal(
    investor_cached_result$model_comparison,
    investor_recomputed_summary$model_comparison,
    tolerance = 1e-12,
    check.attributes = FALSE
  )
  investor_nested_lrt_check <- all.equal(
    investor_cached_result$nested_lrt,
    investor_recomputed_summary$nested_lrt,
    tolerance = 1e-12,
    check.attributes = FALSE
  )
  if (!isTRUE(investor_model_comparison_check)) {
    stop(
      "Authenticated investor model-comparison mismatch: ",
      paste(investor_model_comparison_check, collapse = " | ")
    )
  }
  if (!isTRUE(investor_nested_lrt_check)) {
    stop(
      "Authenticated investor likelihood-ratio mismatch: ",
      paste(investor_nested_lrt_check, collapse = " | ")
    )
  }
  investor_selection_check <- all.equal(
    investor_cached_result$selection_summary,
    investor_recomputed_summary$selection_summary,
    tolerance = 1e-12,
    check.attributes = FALSE
  )
  investor_two_stage_check <- all.equal(
    investor_cached_result$two_stage_summary,
    investor_recomputed_summary$two_stage_summary,
    tolerance = 1e-12,
    check.attributes = FALSE
  )
  if (!isTRUE(investor_selection_check)) {
    stop(
      "Authenticated investor selection-summary mismatch: ",
      paste(investor_selection_check, collapse = " | ")
    )
  }
  if (!isTRUE(investor_two_stage_check)) {
    stop(
      "Authenticated investor two-stage-summary mismatch: ",
      paste(investor_two_stage_check, collapse = " | ")
    )
  }
  stopifnot(
    nrow(investor_cached_result$candidate_fit_log) == 360L,
    !anyDuplicated(
      investor_cached_result$candidate_fit_log[c("state_count", "label")]
    )
  )
  for (state_count in investor_search_settings$state_counts) {
    state_name <- as.character(state_count)
    cached_models <- investor_cached_result$selected_models[[state_name]]
    source_state <- investor_cache_checkpoint$state_results[[state_name]]
    stopifnot(
      investor_fit_converged(cached_models$simple),
      investor_fit_converged(cached_models$group),
      identical(getpars(cached_models$simple), getpars(source_state$simple$model)),
      identical(getpars(cached_models$group), getpars(source_state$group$model)),
      isTRUE(investor_candidate_diagnostics(cached_models$simple)$valid[[1]]),
      isTRUE(investor_candidate_diagnostics(cached_models$group)$valid[[1]])
    )
  }

  investor_standardized_search_result <- investor_cached_result
}

```{r investor-selected-model-analysis, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
investor_state_distribution_summary <- function(model) {
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nstates(model)), function(state) {
    parameters <- getpars(model@response[[state]][[1]])
    response <- truncdiscgaus(
      seq(0, 20),
      pstart = parameters,
      min = -0.5,
      max = 20.5
    )
    probabilities <- dens(response)
    expected_investment <- sum(seq(0, 20) * probabilities)
    tibble::tibble(
      state,
      expected_investment,
      state_standard_deviation = sqrt(sum(
        (seq(0, 20) - expected_investment)^2 * probabilities
      ))
    )
  })
}

investor_assigned_state_analysis <- function(model) {
  state_summary <- investor_state_distribution_summary(model)
  state_values <- state_summary$expected_investment
  posterior_probabilities <-
    forwardbackward(model, return.all = TRUE)$gamma
  stopifnot(
    nrow(posterior_probabilities) == nrow(investor_hmm_dat),
    ncol(posterior_probabilities) == nstates(model)
  )
  assigned <- investor_hmm_dat %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assigned_state = max.col(
        posterior_probabilities,
        ties.method = "first"
      ),
      assigned_state = factor(
        assigned_state,
        levels = seq_len(nstates(model))
      )
    )

  participant_occupancy <- assigned %>%
    dplyr::count(
      subject_ID, group, assigned_state,
      name = "assigned_trials"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      tidyr::nesting(subject_ID, group),
      assigned_state,
      fill = list(assigned_trials = 0L)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(occupancy = assigned_trials / 10)

  occupancy_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(
    levels(participant_occupancy$assigned_state),
    function(state) {
      state_data <- participant_occupancy %>%
        dplyr::filter(assigned_state == state)
      fit <- stats::lm(occupancy ~ group, data = state_data)
      contrast <- emmeans::contrast(
        emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group),
        method = list("CC - BPD" = c(1, -1)),
        adjust = "none"
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame()
      contrast_interval <- emmeans::contrast(
        emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group),
        method = list("CC - BPD" = c(1, -1)),
        adjust = "none"
      ) %>%
        confint() %>%
        as.data.frame()
      lower_column <- grep(
        "lower|LCL",
        names(contrast_interval),
        ignore.case = TRUE,
        value = TRUE
      )[[1]]
      upper_column <- grep(
        "upper|UCL",
        names(contrast_interval),
        ignore.case = TRUE,
        value = TRUE
      )[[1]]
      tibble::tibble(
        state = as.integer(state),
        expected_investment = state_values[[as.integer(state)]],
        cc_mean = mean(
          state_data$occupancy[state_data$group == "CC"]
        ),
        bpd_mean = mean(
          state_data$occupancy[state_data$group == "BPD"]
        ),
        cc_minus_bpd = contrast$estimate[[1]],
        standard_error = contrast$SE[[1]],
        degrees_of_freedom = contrast$df[[1]],
        p_value = contrast$p.value[[1]],
        lower_ci = contrast_interval[[lower_column]][[1]],
        upper_ci = contrast_interval[[upper_column]][[1]]
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_holm = stats::p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")
    )

  transitions <- assigned %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subject_ID) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      next_state = dplyr::lead(as.integer(assigned_state)),
      next_state_expected_investment = state_values[next_state]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(next_state))
  feedback_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    next_state_expected_investment ~
      assigned_state * (invPnL + group) +
      invPnL * group +
      (1 | subject_ID),
    data = transitions,
    REML = FALSE
  )
  feedback_trends <- emmeans::emtrends(
    feedback_model,
    ~ group,
    var = "invPnL"
  )
  feedback_contrast <- emmeans::contrast(
    feedback_trends,
    method = list("CC - BPD" = c(1, -1)),
    adjust = "none"
  )
  feedback_contrast_summary <- as.data.frame(feedback_contrast)
  feedback_contrast_interval <- as.data.frame(confint(feedback_contrast))
  feedback_lower_column <- grep(
    "lower|LCL",
    names(feedback_contrast_interval),
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    value = TRUE
  )[[1]]
  feedback_upper_column <- grep(
    "upper|UCL",
    names(feedback_contrast_interval),
    ignore.case = TRUE,
    value = TRUE
  )[[1]]
  feedback_contrast_summary$lower_ci <-
    feedback_contrast_interval[[feedback_lower_column]]
  feedback_contrast_summary$upper_ci <-
    feedback_contrast_interval[[feedback_upper_column]]

  list(
    state_summary = state_summary,
    state_values = state_values,
    assigned = assigned,
    participant_occupancy = participant_occupancy,
    occupancy_contrasts = occupancy_contrasts,
    feedback_model = feedback_model,
    feedback_trends = as.data.frame(feedback_trends),
    feedback_contrast = feedback_contrast_summary
  )
}

investor_primary_state_analysis <-
  investor_assigned_state_analysis(best_mod_inv_all)
investor_sensitivity_state_analysis <- list(
  four_state_group = investor_assigned_state_analysis(
    investor_standardized_search_result$selected_models[["4"]]$ordered_group
  ),
  six_state_group = investor_assigned_state_analysis(
    investor_standardized_search_result$selected_models[["6"]]$ordered_group
  ),
  five_state_diagnosis_free = investor_assigned_state_analysis(
    investor_standardized_search_result$selected_models[["5"]]$ordered_simple
  )
)

investor_selected_lrt <-
  investor_standardized_search_result$nested_lrt %>%
  dplyr::filter(state_count == inv_best_nstates)
investor_lowest_state <-
  investor_primary_state_analysis$state_summary %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(state, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
investor_highest_state <-
  investor_primary_state_analysis$state_summary %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(state, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
investor_highest_state_occupancy <-
  investor_primary_state_analysis$occupancy_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::filter(state == investor_highest_state$state[[1]])
investor_feedback_cc <-
  investor_primary_state_analysis$feedback_trends %>%
  dplyr::filter(group == "CC")
investor_feedback_bpd <-
  investor_primary_state_analysis$feedback_trends %>%
  dplyr::filter(group == "BPD")
investor_feedback_group_difference <-
  investor_primary_state_analysis$feedback_contrast
stopifnot(
  nrow(investor_selected_lrt) == 1L,
  nrow(investor_lowest_state) == 1L,
  nrow(investor_highest_state) == 1L,
  nrow(investor_highest_state_occupancy) == 1L,
  nrow(investor_feedback_cc) == 1L,
  nrow(investor_feedback_bpd) == 1L,
  nrow(investor_feedback_group_difference) == 1L
)

build_occupancy_significance_brackets <- function(
    occupancy_data, contrast_data, group_levels) {
  significant_contrasts <- contrast_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(adjusted_p),
      adjusted_p < 0.05
    )
  if (nrow(significant_contrasts) == 0L) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }

  contrast_groups <- do.call(
    rbind,
    strsplit(significant_contrasts$contrast, " - ", fixed = TRUE)
  )
  if (ncol(contrast_groups) != 2L) {
    stop("Could not identify the two groups in an occupancy contrast.")
  }
  significant_contrasts$group_1 <- contrast_groups[, 1]
  significant_contrasts$group_2 <- contrast_groups[, 2]

  state_levels <- sort(unique(as.integer(as.character(
    occupancy_data$state
  ))))
  group_offsets <- stats::setNames(
    0.9 * (
      seq_along(group_levels) - (length(group_levels) + 1) / 2
    ) / length(group_levels),
    group_levels
  )
  state_maxima <- occupancy_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = as.integer(as.character(state))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      state_maximum = max(proportion),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  significant_contrasts %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = as.integer(state),
      state_position = match(state, state_levels),
      group_1_position = unname(group_offsets[group_1]),
      group_2_position = unname(group_offsets[group_2]),
      span = abs(group_1_position - group_2_position)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(state_maxima, by = "state") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(span, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bracket_level = dplyr::row_number(),
      bracket_y = state_maximum + 0.035 +
        0.055 * (bracket_level - 1),
      label_y = bracket_y + 0.017,
      x_start = state_position + group_1_position,
      x_end = state_position + group_2_position,
      label = dplyr::case_when(
        adjusted_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        adjusted_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        TRUE ~ "*"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

add_occupancy_significance_brackets <- function(plot, bracket_data) {
  if (nrow(bracket_data) == 0L) {
    return(plot)
  }
  plot_maximum <- max(plot$data$proportion, na.rm = TRUE)
  upper_limit <- max(plot_maximum, bracket_data$label_y) + 0.025
  plot +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = x_start, xend = x_end,
        y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.75
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = x_start, xend = x_start,
        y = bracket_y - 0.010, yend = bracket_y
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.75
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = bracket_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = x_end, xend = x_end,
        y = bracket_y - 0.010, yend = bracket_y
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.75
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = bracket_data,
      ggplot2::aes(x = (x_start + x_end) / 2, y = label_y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      vjust = 0
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, upper_limit),
      clip = "off"
    )
}

```{r investor-classification-certainty, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
# Classification certainty of a selected hidden-state model: the mean smoothed
# probability of each trial's most likely state and the share of trials whose
# most likely state has probability of at least the threshold.
hmm_classification_certainty <- function(model, threshold = 0.80) {
  smoothed <- as.matrix(depmixS4::posterior(model, type = "smoothing"))
  max_posterior <- apply(smoothed, 1, max)
  stopifnot(
    ncol(smoothed) == nstates(model),
    nrow(smoothed) == sum(model@ntimes),
    all(abs(rowSums(smoothed) - 1) < 1e-6),
    all(max_posterior >= 1 / nstates(model))
  )
  list(
    trials = length(max_posterior),
    mean_max_posterior = mean(max_posterior),
    share_confident = mean(max_posterior >= threshold),
    mean_max_posterior_fmt = sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", mean(max_posterior))),
    share_confident_fmt = scales::percent(
      mean(max_posterior >= threshold), accuracy = 1
    )
  )
}
investor_classification_certainty <- hmm_classification_certainty(
  best_mod_inv_all
)
stopifnot(investor_classification_certainty$trials == 4140L)
```

For investors, BIC selected `r inv_best_nstates` states within the group-dependent model family. At this state count, allowing transitions to differ between BPD and CC improved fit over the diagnosis-free model ($\chi^2$(`r investor_selected_lrt$degrees_of_freedom[[1]]`) = `r scales::number(investor_selected_lrt$statistic[[1]], accuracy = 0.01)`, *p* `r format_pval_clause(investor_selected_lrt$p_value[[1]])`; Supplement Table S24). The states ranged from very low investment (State `r investor_lowest_state$state[[1]]`, *M* = `r scales::number(investor_lowest_state$expected_investment[[1]], accuracy = 0.01)` tokens) to near-maximal investment (State `r investor_highest_state$state[[1]]`, *M* = `r scales::number(investor_highest_state$expected_investment[[1]], accuracy = 0.01)` tokens). Trials were assigned to states with moderate certainty: the mean probability of the most likely state was `r investor_classification_certainty$mean_max_posterior_fmt`, and `r investor_classification_certainty$share_confident_fmt` of trials were assigned with a probability of at least .80.

```{r investor-hmm-state-panel, include=TRUE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.8, out.width='100%', fig.cap=investor_state_panel_caption}
print(investor_state_panel_plot)
```

CC investors occupied the highest-investment state more often than BPD investors (`r scales::percent(investor_highest_state_occupancy$cc_mean[[1]], accuracy = 0.1)` vs `r scales::percent(investor_highest_state_occupancy$bpd_mean[[1]], accuracy = 0.1)`; difference = `r scales::number(100 * investor_highest_state_occupancy$cc_minus_bpd[[1]], accuracy = 0.1)` percentage points, 95% CI [`r scales::number(100 * investor_highest_state_occupancy$lower_ci[[1]], accuracy = 0.1)`, `r scales::number(100 * investor_highest_state_occupancy$upper_ci[[1]], accuracy = 0.1)`], Holm-adjusted *p* `r format_pval_clause(investor_highest_state_occupancy$p_holm[[1]])`). Larger net earnings predicted a move towards higher-investment states in both groups, but this adjustment was smaller in BPD. Each additional token earned predicted a `r scales::number(investor_feedback_cc$invPnL.trend[[1]], accuracy = 0.001)`-token increase in the mean investment of the next state in CC and a `r scales::number(investor_feedback_bpd$invPnL.trend[[1]], accuracy = 0.001)`-token increase in BPD (difference = `r scales::number(investor_feedback_group_difference$estimate[[1]], accuracy = 0.001)`, 95% CI [`r scales::number(investor_feedback_group_difference$lower_ci[[1]], accuracy = 0.001)`, `r scales::number(investor_feedback_group_difference$upper_ci[[1]], accuracy = 0.001)`], *p* `r format_pval_clause(investor_feedback_group_difference$p.value[[1]])`). Analyses using four- and six-state models, and a five-state model estimated without group terms, supported both findings. Full results are reported in the Supplement.

trustee_fit_converged <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(FALSE)
  paste(model@message, collapse = " ") %in% c(
    "Log likelihood converged to within tol. (relative change)",
    "Log likelihood converged to within tol. (absolute change)"
  ) && is.finite(as.numeric(logLik(model)))
}

trustee_warm_start <- function(simple_fit, group_structure, state_count) {
  original <- getpars(simple_fit)
  prior_covariates <- 2L
  simple_transition_covariates <- 2L
  group_transition_covariates <- 6L
  new_parameters <- original[seq_len(state_count * prior_covariates)]

  for (from_state in seq_len(state_count)) {
    first <- state_count * prior_covariates + 1L +
      (from_state - 1L) * simple_transition_covariates * state_count
    last <- first + simple_transition_covariates * state_count - 1L
    simple_matrix <- matrix(
      original[first:last], ncol = simple_transition_covariates
    )
    expanded <- matrix(
      0, nrow = state_count, ncol = group_transition_covariates
    )
    expanded[, 1:2] <- simple_matrix
    new_parameters <- c(new_parameters, as.numeric(expanded))
  }

  response_first <- state_count * prior_covariates + 1L +
    state_count * simple_transition_covariates * state_count
  new_parameters <- c(
    new_parameters, original[response_first:length(original)]
  )
  stopifnot(length(new_parameters) == length(getpars(group_structure)))
  setpars(group_structure, new_parameters)
}

trustee_perturb_start <- function(model, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  state_count <- nstates(model)
  prior_parameters <- getpars(model@prior)
  prior_fixed <- getpars(model@prior, which = "fixed")
  prior_parameters[!prior_fixed] <- prior_parameters[!prior_fixed] +
    rnorm(sum(!prior_fixed), sd = 0.02)
  complete_parameters <- prior_parameters

  for (state in seq_len(state_count)) {
    transition_parameters <- getpars(model@transition[[state]])
    transition_fixed <- getpars(
      model@transition[[state]], which = "fixed"
    )
    transition_parameters[!transition_fixed] <-
      transition_parameters[!transition_fixed] +
      rnorm(sum(!transition_fixed), sd = 0.02)
    complete_parameters <- c(complete_parameters, transition_parameters)
  }

  for (state in seq_len(state_count)) {
    response_parameters <- getpars(model@response[[state]][[1]])
    response_parameters[[1]] <- response_parameters[[1]] +
      rnorm(1, sd = 0.005)
    response_parameters[[2]] <- response_parameters[[2]] *
      exp(rnorm(1, sd = 0.02))
    complete_parameters <- c(complete_parameters, response_parameters)
  }

  stopifnot(length(complete_parameters) == length(getpars(model)))
  output <- setpars(model, complete_parameters)
  cache_error <- max(
    abs(output@init - dens(output@prior)),
    max(vapply(seq_len(state_count), function(state) {
      max(abs(
        output@trDens[, , state] - dens(output@transition[[state]])
      ))
    }, numeric(1))),
    max(vapply(seq_len(state_count), function(state) {
      max(abs(
        output@dens[, 1, state] - dens(output@response[[state]][[1]])
      ))
    }, numeric(1)))
  )
  if (!is.finite(cache_error) || cache_error > 1e-12) {
    stop("Perturbed HMM probability-cache mismatch: ", cache_error)
  }
  output
}

trustee_fit_route <- function(
    model, state_count, family, label, seed, iterations,
    package_random_start = FALSE, parent = NA_character_) {
  set.seed(seed)
  warnings_seen <- character()
  fitted <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      fit(
        model,
        emcontrol = em.control(
          maxit = iterations,
          tol = 1e-8,
          crit = "relative",
          random.start = package_random_start
        )
      ),
      warning = function(condition) {
        warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(condition))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(condition) condition
  )
  error_message <- if (inherits(fitted, "error")) {
    conditionMessage(fitted)
  } else {
    ""
  }
  if (inherits(fitted, "error")) fitted <- NULL

  list(
    model = fitted,
    log = tibble::tibble(
      state_count = state_count,
      family = family,
      label = label,
      parent = parent,
      seed = seed,
      iterations = iterations,
      initialization = if (package_random_start) {
        "depmixS4_random_gamma_emission_refit"
      } else {
        "provided_parameter_start"
      },
      converged = trustee_fit_converged(fitted),
      log_likelihood = if (is.null(fitted)) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        as.numeric(logLik(fitted))
      },
      warnings = paste(unique(warnings_seen), collapse = " | "),
      error = error_message
    )
  )
}

trustee_membership_search <- function(
    template, state_count, family, seed_offset) {
  screens <- lapply(
    seq_len(trustee_search_settings$screen_starts),
    function(start_id) {
      trustee_fit_route(
        template,
        state_count,
        family,
        paste0(family, "_membership_screen_", sprintf("%02d", start_id)),
        trustee_search_settings$base_seed + state_count * 100000L +
          seed_offset + start_id,
        trustee_search_settings$screen_iterations,
        package_random_start = TRUE
      )
    }
  )
  successful <- which(vapply(
    screens, function(item) !is.null(item$model), logical(1)
  ))
  if (length(successful) < trustee_search_settings$full_starts) {
    stop("Too few successful membership screens for K=", state_count)
  }
  likelihoods <- vapply(
    screens[successful],
    function(item) as.numeric(logLik(item$model)),
    numeric(1)
  )
  chosen <- successful[order(likelihoods, decreasing = TRUE)[
    seq_len(trustee_search_settings$full_starts)
  ]]
  promoted <- lapply(
    seq_len(trustee_search_settings$full_starts),
    function(rank) {
      screen_id <- chosen[[rank]]
      trustee_fit_route(
        screens[[screen_id]]$model,
        state_count,
        family,
        paste0(
          family, "_membership_full_", sprintf("%02d", rank),
          "_screen_", sprintf("%02d", screen_id)
        ),
        trustee_search_settings$base_seed + state_count * 100000L +
          seed_offset + 1000L + rank,
        trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
        parent = screens[[screen_id]]$log$label[[1]]
      )
    }
  )
  list(
    candidates = promoted,
    logs = dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(screens, `[[`, "log"),
      lapply(promoted, `[[`, "log")
    )
  )
}

trustee_candidate_diagnostics <- function(model) {
  if (!trustee_fit_converged(model)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      valid = FALSE,
      minimum_occupancy = NA_real_,
      minimum_sigma = NA_real_,
      reason = "nonconverged"
    ))
  }
  ordered <- order_mod_vtdgaus(model)
  occupancy <- colMeans(
    forwardbackward(ordered, return.all = TRUE)$gamma
  )
  sigmas <- vapply(seq_len(nstates(ordered)), function(state) {
    unname(getpars(ordered@response[[state]][[1]])[[2]])
  }, numeric(1))
  transition_parameters <- unlist(lapply(ordered@transition, getpars))
  finite <- all(is.finite(c(
    occupancy, sigmas, transition_parameters, getpars(ordered)
  )))
  valid <- finite && min(occupancy) >= 0.005 && min(sigmas) > 1e-6
  tibble::tibble(
    valid = valid,
    minimum_occupancy = min(occupancy),
    minimum_sigma = min(sigmas),
    maximum_absolute_transition_parameter = max(abs(transition_parameters)),
    reason = if (valid) {
      "valid"
    } else if (!finite) {
      "nonfinite"
    } else {
      "degenerate"
    }
  )
}

trustee_select_candidate <- function(candidates, state_count, family) {
  comparison <- purrr::map_dfr(candidates, function(item) {
    dplyr::bind_cols(item$log, trustee_candidate_diagnostics(item$model))
  })
  valid_rows <- which(comparison$valid)
  if (!length(valid_rows)) {
    stop("No valid ", family, " candidate for K=", state_count)
  }
  best_row <- valid_rows[[which.max(
    comparison$log_likelihood[valid_rows]
  )]]
  best_label <- comparison$label[[best_row]]
  best_item <- candidates[[which(vapply(
    candidates,
    function(item) identical(item$log$label[[1]], best_label),
    logical(1)
  ))]]
  list(
    model = best_item$model,
    ordered_model = order_mod_vtdgaus(best_item$model),
    label = best_label,
    comparison = comparison %>%
      mutate(selected = label == best_label) %>%
      arrange(desc(valid), desc(log_likelihood))
  )
}

trustee_rescue_candidates <- function(candidates, state_count, family) {
  candidate_is_valid <- function(item) {
    isTRUE(trustee_candidate_diagnostics(item$model)$valid[[1]])
  }
  if (any(vapply(candidates, candidate_is_valid, logical(1)))) {
    return(candidates)
  }
  active <- purrr::keep(candidates, function(item) {
    !is.null(item$model) && is.finite(as.numeric(logLik(item$model)))
  })
  if (!length(active)) return(candidates)
  active <- active[order(
    vapply(active, function(item) as.numeric(logLik(item$model)), numeric(1)),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )]
  rescue_width <- if (family == "simple") {
    length(active)
  } else {
    trustee_search_settings$full_starts
  }
  active <- utils::head(active, rescue_width)

  for (round_id in seq_len(trustee_search_settings$rescue_rounds)) {
    rescued <- lapply(seq_along(active), function(rank) {
      parent_label <- active[[rank]]$log$label[[1]]
      trustee_fit_route(
        active[[rank]]$model,
        state_count,
        family,
        paste0(
          family, "_rescue_round_", sprintf("%02d", round_id),
          "_rank_", sprintf("%02d", rank)
        ),
        trustee_search_settings$base_seed + state_count * 100000L +
          ifelse(family == "simple", 80000L, 90000L) +
          round_id * 100L + rank,
        trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
        parent = parent_label
      )
    })
    candidates <- c(candidates, rescued)
    if (any(vapply(rescued, candidate_is_valid, logical(1)))) {
      return(candidates)
    }
    active <- purrr::keep(rescued, function(item) !is.null(item$model))
    if (!length(active)) return(candidates)
  }
  candidates
}

trustee_search_state_count <- function(state_count) {
  simple_membership <- trustee_membership_search(
    simple_HMMs[[state_count]], state_count, "simple", 10000L
  )
  simple_direct <- trustee_fit_route(
    simple_HMMs[[state_count]],
    state_count,
    "simple",
    "simple_structured_direct",
    trustee_search_settings$base_seed,
    trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
    parent = "simple_structured_template"
  )
  simple_candidates <- trustee_rescue_candidates(
    c(simple_membership$candidates, list(simple_direct)),
    state_count,
    "simple"
  )
  best_simple <- trustee_select_candidate(
    simple_candidates, state_count, "simple"
  )

  group_membership <- trustee_membership_search(
    Ctrst_HMMs[[state_count]], state_count, "group", 50000L
  )
  group_direct <- trustee_fit_route(
    Ctrst_HMMs[[state_count]],
    state_count,
    "group",
    "group_structured_direct",
    trustee_search_settings$base_seed,
    trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
    parent = "group_structured_template"
  )
  best_simple_warm_start <- trustee_warm_start(
    best_simple$model, Ctrst_HMMs[[state_count]], state_count
  )
  group_best_simple_warm <- trustee_fit_route(
    best_simple_warm_start,
    state_count,
    "group",
    "group_best_simple_warm",
    trustee_search_settings$base_seed,
    trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
    parent = best_simple$label
  )
  if (trustee_fit_converged(simple_direct$model)) {
    structured_warm_start <- trustee_warm_start(
      simple_direct$model, Ctrst_HMMs[[state_count]], state_count
    )
    group_structured_warm <- trustee_fit_route(
      structured_warm_start,
      state_count,
      "group",
      "group_structured_warm",
      trustee_search_settings$base_seed,
      trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
      parent = "simple_structured_direct"
    )
    perturbation_warm_start <- structured_warm_start
    perturbation_warm_parent <- "group_structured_warm_start"
  } else {
    group_structured_warm <- list(
      model = NULL,
      log = tibble::tibble(
        state_count = state_count,
        family = "group",
        label = "group_structured_warm",
        parent = "simple_structured_direct",
        seed = trustee_search_settings$base_seed,
        iterations = trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
        initialization = "unavailable_nonconverged_parent",
        converged = FALSE,
        log_likelihood = NA_real_,
        warnings = "",
        error = "Structured simple parent did not converge"
      )
    )
    perturbation_warm_start <- best_simple_warm_start
    perturbation_warm_parent <- "group_best_simple_warm_start"
  }

  perturbations <- unlist(lapply(c("direct", "warm"), function(route) {
    base_model <- if (route == "direct") {
      Ctrst_HMMs[[state_count]]
    } else {
      perturbation_warm_start
    }
    parent_label <- if (route == "direct") {
      "group_structured_direct_start"
    } else {
      perturbation_warm_parent
    }
    route_offset <- if (route == "direct") 1000L else 2000L
    lapply(seq_len(trustee_search_settings$perturbations), function(index) {
      perturbation_seed <- trustee_search_settings$base_seed +
        route_offset + index
      label <- paste0(
        "group_perturbed_", route, "_", sprintf("%02d", index)
      )
      perturbed <- tryCatch(
        trustee_perturb_start(base_model, perturbation_seed),
        error = function(condition) condition
      )
      if (inherits(perturbed, "error")) {
        list(
          model = NULL,
          log = tibble::tibble(
            state_count = state_count,
            family = "group",
            label = label,
            parent = parent_label,
            seed = perturbation_seed,
            iterations = trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
            initialization = "provided_parameter_start",
            converged = FALSE,
            log_likelihood = NA_real_,
            warnings = "",
            error = conditionMessage(perturbed)
          )
        )
      } else {
        trustee_fit_route(
          perturbed,
          state_count,
          "group",
          label,
          perturbation_seed,
          trustee_search_settings$max_iterations,
          parent = parent_label
        )
      }
    })
  }), recursive = FALSE)

  group_candidates <- trustee_rescue_candidates(
    c(
      group_membership$candidates,
      list(group_direct, group_structured_warm, group_best_simple_warm),
      perturbations
    ),
    state_count,
    "group"
  )
  best_group <- trustee_select_candidate(
    group_candidates,
    state_count,
    "group"
  )
  list(simple = best_simple, group = best_group)
}

trustee_summarise_search <- function(state_results) {
  model_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(state_results, function(result, state_name) {
    purrr::map_dfr(c("simple", "group"), function(family) {
      selected <- result[[family]]
      likelihood <- as.numeric(logLik(selected$model))
      parameters <- as.integer(attr(logLik(selected$model), "df"))
      diagnostics <- trustee_candidate_diagnostics(selected$model)
      tibble::tibble(
        state_count = as.integer(state_name),
        family = family,
        selected_label = selected$label,
        log_likelihood = likelihood,
        parameters = parameters,
        AIC = -2 * likelihood + 2 * parameters,
        BIC_trials = -2 * likelihood + parameters * log(nrow(trustee_dat)),
        BIC_sequences = -2 * likelihood + parameters * log(nrow(priordat_trst)),
        valid_candidates = sum(selected$comparison$valid),
        converged_candidates = sum(selected$comparison$converged),
        near_best_candidates = sum(
          selected$comparison$valid &
            selected$comparison$log_likelihood >= likelihood - 1
        ),
        minimum_occupancy = diagnostics$minimum_occupancy,
        minimum_sigma = diagnostics$minimum_sigma
      )
    })
  })
  nested_tests <- purrr::imap_dfr(state_results, function(result, state_name) {
    statistic <- 2 * (
      as.numeric(logLik(result$group$model)) -
        as.numeric(logLik(result$simple$model))
    )
    if (statistic < -1e-6) {
      stop("Nested-model likelihood ordering failed for K=", state_name)
    }
    statistic <- max(0, statistic)
    degrees_of_freedom <-
      attr(logLik(result$group$model), "df") -
      attr(logLik(result$simple$model), "df")
    tibble::tibble(
      state_count = as.integer(state_name),
      group_log_likelihood = as.numeric(logLik(result$group$model)),
      simple_log_likelihood = as.numeric(logLik(result$simple$model)),
      statistic = statistic,
      degrees_of_freedom = degrees_of_freedom,
      p_value = pchisq(statistic, degrees_of_freedom, lower.tail = FALSE)
    )
  })
  group_table <- model_table %>% filter(family == "group")
  selection_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    criterion = c("AIC", "BIC_trials", "BIC_sequences"),
    selected_state_count = c(
      group_table$state_count[[which.min(group_table$AIC)]],
      group_table$state_count[[which.min(group_table$BIC_trials)]],
      group_table$state_count[[which.min(group_table$BIC_sequences)]]
    )
  )
  list(
    model_comparison = model_table,
    nested_lrt = nested_tests,
    selection_summary = selection_summary,
    five_state_lrt = nested_tests %>% filter(state_count == 5L)
  )
}

trustee_validate_recomputed_search <- function(result, settings, path) {
  required_fields <- c(
    "config", "model_comparison", "selection_summary", "nested_lrt",
    "five_state_lrt", "selected_models"
  )
  if (!all(required_fields %in% names(result))) {
    stop("The recomputed trustee search at ", path, " lacks required fields")
  }
  for (field in trustee_search_config_fields) {
    if (!identical(result$config[[field]], settings[[field]])) {
      stop(
        "The recomputed trustee search at ", path, " used a different ",
        field, " from the current search settings"
      )
    }
  }
  state_labels <- as.character(settings$state_counts)
  if (!identical(names(result$selected_models), state_labels)) {
    stop("The recomputed trustee search at ", path, " covers other state counts")
  }
  state_counts_agree <- vapply(state_labels, function(label) {
    models <- result$selected_models[[label]]
    all(c(
      nstates(models$simple), nstates(models$group),
      nstates(models$ordered_group)
    ) == as.integer(label))
  }, logical(1))
  if (!all(state_counts_agree)) {
    stop("A stored model in ", path, " has an unexpected number of states")
  }
  current_data_hash <- digest::digest(
    file = file.path("Data", "full_RTG_data.csv"), algo = "sha256"
  )
  if (is.null(result$data_sha256)) {
    cat(
      "Note: the reused trustee search at ", path,
      " records no behavioural-data hash and cannot be tied to the current",
      " data file.\n",
      sep = "", file = stderr()
    )
  } else if (!identical(result$data_sha256, current_data_hash)) {
    stop("The recomputed trustee search at ", path, " used different data")
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
