```{r trustee-corrected-five-state-recompute-functions, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
# Fit trustee transition models and calculate cooperation measures.
# The package stores expected transitions as [next state, current state]; the
# arrays are transposed once here before current-state multinomial models are
# constructed.
trustee_analysis_diagnoses <- c("CC", "BPD", "AD")
trustee_analysis_investments <- c(5, 10, 15)
trustee_analysis_groups <- list(
  clearly_low_return = 1L,
  near_one_third = 2L,
  cooperative = 3:5
)

trustee_expected_state_means <- function(model) {
  purrr::map_dbl(seq_len(nstates(model)), function(state) {
    support <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 61L)
    response <- vtdgaus(
      support,
      pstart = getpars(model@response[[state]][[1]]),
      yield = rep(60, length(support))
    )
    sum(support * dens(response))
  })
}

trustee_expected_transitions <- function(
    model, data, id_column = "subject_ID") {
  state_count <- nstates(model)
  sequence_ids <- as.character(data[[id_column]])
  sequence_index <- split(
    seq_len(nrow(data)),
    factor(sequence_ids, levels = unique(sequence_ids))
  )
  forward_backward <- depmixS4::forwardbackward(
    model,
    return.all = TRUE
  )
  xi_next_current <- forward_backward$xi
  if (!identical(
    dim(xi_next_current),
    c(nrow(data), state_count, state_count)
  )) {
    stop("Unexpected expected-transition array dimensions")
  }

  purrr::imap(sequence_index, function(indices, sequence_name) {
    sequence_length <- length(indices)
    if (sequence_length < 2L) return(NULL)
    transition_rows <- indices[seq_len(sequence_length - 1L)]
    xi_current_next <- aperm(
      xi_next_current[transition_rows, , , drop = FALSE],
      c(1, 3, 2)
    )
    current_marginal <- apply(xi_current_next, c(1, 2), sum)
    expected_marginal <- forward_backward$gamma[
      transition_rows, , drop = FALSE
    ]
    orientation_error <- max(abs(
      current_marginal - expected_marginal
    ))
    if (!is.finite(orientation_error) || orientation_error > 1e-6) {
      stop(
        "Expected-transition direction check failed for participant ",
        sequence_name,
        "; maximum error = ", orientation_error
      )
    }
    list(indices = indices, xi = xi_current_next)
  })
}

trustee_integerize_expected_counts <- function(
    fractional_counts, scale = 2000L, tolerance = 1e-12) {
  fractional_totals <- rowSums(fractional_counts)
  keep <- fractional_totals > tolerance
  kept <- fractional_counts[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(kept)) {
    return(list(counts = kept, kept_rows = integer()))
  }
  counts <- round(kept * scale)
  tiny <- which(rowSums(counts) == 0 & fractional_totals[keep] > 0)
  for (row in tiny) counts[row, which.max(kept[row, ])] <- 1L
  storage.mode(counts) <- "integer"
  list(counts = counts, kept_rows = which(keep))
}

trustee_build_transition_frames <- function(
    model, data, expected_transitions, count_scale = 2000L) {
  state_count <- nstates(model)
  count_blocks <- replicate(state_count, list(), simplify = FALSE)
  covariate_blocks <- replicate(state_count, list(), simplify = FALSE)

  for (entry in expected_transitions) {
    if (is.null(entry)) next
    indices <- entry$indices
    xi <- entry$xi
    covariates <- data[
      indices[seq_len(length(indices) - 1L)], , drop = FALSE
    ] %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        next_investment = .data$next_investment,
        BPD = as.integer(.data$group == "BPD"),
        AD = as.integer(.data$group == "AD")
      )
    for (current_state in seq_len(state_count)) {
      count_blocks[[current_state]][[
        length(count_blocks[[current_state]]) + 1L
      ]] <- xi[, current_state, , drop = FALSE]
      covariate_blocks[[current_state]][[
        length(covariate_blocks[[current_state]]) + 1L
      ]] <- covariates
    }
  }

  purrr::map(seq_len(state_count), function(current_state) {
    if (!length(count_blocks[[current_state]])) return(NULL)
    fractional <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(
        count_blocks[[current_state]],
        matrix,
        ncol = state_count
      )
    )
    predictors <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      covariate_blocks[[current_state]]
    )
    integerized <- trustee_integerize_expected_counts(
      fractional,
      scale = count_scale
    )
    if (!nrow(integerized$counts)) return(NULL)
    predictors <- predictors[
      integerized$kept_rows, , drop = FALSE
    ]
    totals <- rowSums(integerized$counts)
    keep <- totals > 0
    list(
      counts = integerized$counts[keep, , drop = FALSE],
      predictors = predictors[keep, , drop = FALSE],
      totals = totals[keep],
      state_count = state_count
    )
  })
}

trustee_ensure_destination_levels <- function(data, classes) {
  totals <- data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(to_state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(total = sum(weight), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(to_state = as.character(to_state))
  required <- union(
    setdiff(as.character(classes), totals$to_state),
    totals$to_state[totals$total <= 0]
  )
  if (!length(required)) return(data)
  dummy <- purrr::map_dfr(required, function(state) {
    data[1, ] %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        to_state = factor(state, levels = levels(data$to_state)),
        weight = 1e-6
      )
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(data, dummy)
}

trustee_transition_block_is_valid <- function(block) {
  if (is.null(block) || is.null(block$fit)) return(FALSE)
  if (is.null(block$fit$convergence) || block$fit$convergence != 0L) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(coef(block$fit)))) return(FALSE)
  probe <- tryCatch(
    predict(
      block$fit,
      newdata = expand.grid(
        next_investment = trustee_analysis_investments,
        BPD = c(0L, 1L, 0L),
        AD = c(0L, 0L, 1L)
      ),
      type = "probs"
    ),
    error = function(condition) condition
  )
  !inherits(probe, "error") && all(is.finite(probe))
}

trustee_fit_transition_block <- function(frame, decay = 1e-6) {
  if (is.null(frame) || !nrow(frame$counts)) return(NULL)
  counts <- frame$counts
  predictors <- frame$predictors
  state_count <- frame$state_count
  long_data <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    row_id = seq_len(nrow(counts)),
    to_state = factor(seq_len(state_count), levels = seq_len(state_count))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      weight = as.vector(t(counts)),
      next_investment = predictors$next_investment[row_id],
      BPD = predictors$BPD[row_id],
      AD = predictors$AD[row_id]
    ) %>%
    trustee_ensure_destination_levels(seq_len(state_count)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(weight > 0)
  fitted <- tryCatch(
    nnet::multinom(
      to_state ~ next_investment + BPD + AD +
        next_investment:BPD + next_investment:AD,
      data = long_data,
      weights = weight,
      trace = FALSE,
      Hess = FALSE,
      maxit = 200,
      decay = decay,
      MaxNWts = 20000
    ),
    error = function(condition) NULL
  )
  block <- list(
    fit = fitted,
    row_predictors = predictors,
    row_totals = frame$totals,
    state_count = state_count
  )
  if (trustee_transition_block_is_valid(block)) block else NULL
}

trustee_predict_transition_row <- function(
    block, investment, diagnosis) {
  state_count <- block$state_count
  new_data <- data.frame(
    next_investment = investment,
    BPD = as.integer(diagnosis == "BPD"),
    AD = as.integer(diagnosis == "AD")
  )
  raw <- predict(block$fit, newdata = new_data, type = "probs")
  desired <- as.character(seq_len(state_count))
  output <- setNames(numeric(state_count), desired)
  if (is.null(dim(raw))) {
    labels <- names(raw)
    if (is.null(labels)) labels <- desired[seq_along(raw)]
    output[labels] <- as.numeric(raw)
  } else {
    labels <- colnames(raw)
    if (is.null(labels)) labels <- desired[seq_len(ncol(raw))]
    output[labels] <- as.numeric(raw[1, ])
  }
  total <- sum(output)
  if (!is.finite(total) || total <= 0) {
    output[] <- 1 / state_count
  } else {
    output <- output / total
  }
  output
}

trustee_simulate_transition_block <- function(
    block, count_scale = 2000L, decay = 1e-6) {
  if (is.null(block)) return(NULL)
  desired <- as.character(seq_len(block$state_count))
  probabilities <- as.matrix(predict(
    block$fit,
    newdata = block$row_predictors,
    type = "probs"
  ))
  if (is.null(colnames(probabilities))) {
    colnames(probabilities) <- desired[seq_len(ncol(probabilities))]
  }
  missing <- setdiff(desired, colnames(probabilities))
  if (length(missing)) {
    probabilities <- cbind(
      probabilities,
      matrix(
        0,
        nrow(probabilities),
        length(missing),
        dimnames = list(NULL, missing)
      )
    )
  }
  probabilities <- probabilities[, desired, drop = FALSE]
  simulated <- t(vapply(seq_len(nrow(probabilities)), function(row) {
    inclusion_probability <- min(
      block$row_totals[row] / count_scale,
      1
    )
    size <- stats::rbinom(1, 1, inclusion_probability)
    if (!size) {
      numeric(length(desired))
    } else {
      as.numeric(stats::rmultinom(1, 1, probabilities[row, ]))
    }
  }, numeric(length(desired))))
  long_data <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    row_id = seq_len(nrow(simulated)),
    to_state = factor(desired, levels = desired)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      weight = as.vector(t(simulated)),
      next_investment = block$row_predictors$next_investment[row_id],
      BPD = block$row_predictors$BPD[row_id],
      AD = block$row_predictors$AD[row_id]
    ) %>%
    trustee_ensure_destination_levels(desired) %>%
    dplyr::filter(weight > 0)
  refitted <- tryCatch(
    nnet::multinom(
      to_state ~ next_investment + BPD + AD +
        next_investment:BPD + next_investment:AD,
      data = long_data,
      weights = weight,
      trace = FALSE,
      Hess = FALSE,
      maxit = 200,
      decay = decay,
      MaxNWts = 20000
    ),
    error = function(condition) NULL
  )
  candidate <- list(
    fit = refitted,
    row_predictors = block$row_predictors,
    row_totals = block$row_totals,
    state_count = block$state_count
  )
  if (trustee_transition_block_is_valid(candidate)) candidate else NULL
}

trustee_stationary_distribution <- function(transition_matrix) {
  transition_matrix[!is.finite(transition_matrix)] <- 0
  for (row in seq_len(nrow(transition_matrix))) {
    total <- sum(transition_matrix[row, ])
    transition_matrix[row, ] <- if (total <= 0) {
      rep(1 / ncol(transition_matrix), ncol(transition_matrix))
    } else {
      transition_matrix[row, ] / total
    }
  }
  eigensystem <- eigen(t(transition_matrix))
  stationary <- Re(eigensystem$vectors[
    , which.min(Mod(eigensystem$values - 1))
  ])
  stationary / sum(stationary)
}

trustee_compose_transition_matrix <- function(
    blocks, investment, diagnosis) {
  state_count <- length(blocks)
  transition_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, state_count, state_count)
  for (current_state in seq_len(state_count)) {
    transition_matrix[current_state, ] <- trustee_predict_transition_row(
      blocks[[current_state]], investment, diagnosis
    )
  }
  row_error <- max(abs(rowSums(transition_matrix) - 1))
  if (!is.finite(row_error) || row_error > 1e-10) {
    stop("Invalid reconstructed transition matrix")
  }
  transition_matrix
}

trustee_direct_transition_matrix <- function(
    model, data, investment, diagnosis) {
  state_count <- nstates(model)
  output <- matrix(NA_real_, state_count, state_count)
  diagnosis_rows <- which(as.character(data$group) == diagnosis)
  if (!length(diagnosis_rows)) stop("Unknown diagnosis: ", diagnosis)

  for (current_state in seq_len(state_count)) {
    transition_model <- model@transition[[current_state]]
    design_names <- colnames(transition_model@x)
    if (nrow(transition_model@x) != nrow(data)) {
      stop("Transition design and trustee data have different row counts")
    }
    design <- setNames(rep(0, length(design_names)), design_names)
    design["(Intercept)"] <- 1
    design["next_investment"] <- investment
    for (term in c("BPD_ctrst1", "AD_ctrst1")) {
      fitted_value <- unique(
        transition_model@x[diagnosis_rows, term]
      )
      if (length(fitted_value) != 1L) {
        stop("Diagnosis coding is not constant for ", term)
      }
      design[term] <- fitted_value
      forward <- paste0("next_investment:", term)
      reverse <- paste0(term, ":next_investment")
      if (forward %in% design_names) {
        design[forward] <- investment * fitted_value
      }
      if (reverse %in% design_names) {
        design[reverse] <- investment * fitted_value
      }
    }
    coefficients <- transition_model@parameters$coefficients[
      design_names, , drop = FALSE
    ]
    linear_predictors <- as.numeric(design %*% coefficients)
    stabilized <- linear_predictors - max(linear_predictors)
    output[current_state, ] <- exp(stabilized) / sum(exp(stabilized))
  }
  row_error <- max(abs(rowSums(output) - 1))
  if (!is.finite(row_error) || row_error > 1e-10 ||
      any(!is.finite(output))) {
    stop("Direct fitted-model transition matrix is invalid")
  }
  output
}

trustee_weighted_transition_probability <- function(
    transition_matrix, stationary, from_states, to_states) {
  denominator <- sum(stationary[from_states])
  numerator <- sum(
    stationary[from_states] *
      rowSums(
        transition_matrix[
          from_states, to_states, drop = FALSE
        ]
      )
  )
  if (denominator > 0) numerator / denominator else NA_real_
}

trustee_five_state_metrics <- function(transition_matrix) {
  stationary <- trustee_stationary_distribution(transition_matrix)
  groups <- trustee_analysis_groups
  c(
    retention = trustee_weighted_transition_probability(
      transition_matrix,
      stationary,
      groups$cooperative,
      groups$cooperative
    ),
    entry_from_clearly_low_return =
      trustee_weighted_transition_probability(
        transition_matrix,
        stationary,
        groups$clearly_low_return,
        groups$cooperative
      ),
    entry_from_near_one_third =
      trustee_weighted_transition_probability(
        transition_matrix,
        stationary,
        groups$near_one_third,
        groups$cooperative
      ),
    exit_to_clearly_low_return =
      trustee_weighted_transition_probability(
        transition_matrix,
        stationary,
        groups$cooperative,
        groups$clearly_low_return
      ),
    exit_to_near_one_third =
      trustee_weighted_transition_probability(
        transition_matrix,
        stationary,
        groups$cooperative,
        groups$near_one_third
      ),
    stationary_cooperation = sum(stationary[groups$cooperative]),
    stationary_clearly_low_return =
      sum(stationary[groups$clearly_low_return]),
    stationary_near_one_third =
      sum(stationary[groups$near_one_third])
  )
}

trustee_transition_metric_grid <- function(blocks) {
  purrr::map_dfr(trustee_analysis_diagnoses, function(diagnosis) {
    purrr::map_dfr(trustee_analysis_investments, function(investment) {
      values <- trustee_five_state_metrics(
        trustee_compose_transition_matrix(
          blocks, investment, diagnosis
        )
      )
      tibble::tibble(
        diagnosis = diagnosis,
        investment = investment,
        metric = names(values),
        value = as.numeric(values)
      )
    })
  })
}

trustee_direct_metric_grid <- function(model, data) {
  purrr::map_dfr(trustee_analysis_diagnoses, function(diagnosis) {
    purrr::map_dfr(trustee_analysis_investments, function(investment) {
      values <- trustee_five_state_metrics(
        trustee_direct_transition_matrix(
          model, data, investment, diagnosis
        )
      )
      tibble::tibble(
        diagnosis = diagnosis,
        investment = investment,
        metric = names(values),
        value = as.numeric(values)
      )
    })
  })
}

trustee_bootstrap_correction_family <- function(metric) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    metric %in% c(
      "retention",
      "entry_from_clearly_low_return",
      "entry_from_near_one_third"
    ) ~ "retention_and_entry",
    metric %in% c(
      "exit_to_clearly_low_return",
      "exit_to_near_one_third"
    ) ~ "exit_destination",
    metric == "stationary_cooperation" ~ "stationary_cooperation",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

trustee_summarise_bootstrap <- function(draws, point) {
  levels <- draws %>%
    dplyr::group_by(diagnosis, investment, metric) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      bootstrap_mean = mean(value),
      lower = stats::quantile(value, 0.025),
      upper = stats::quantile(value, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      point %>% dplyr::rename(point_estimate = value),
      by = c("diagnosis", "investment", "metric")
    )
  inferential_metrics <- c(
    "retention",
    "entry_from_clearly_low_return",
    "entry_from_near_one_third",
    "exit_to_clearly_low_return",
    "exit_to_near_one_third",
    "stationary_cooperation"
  )
  contrast_draws <- draws %>%
    dplyr::filter(metric %in% inferential_metrics) %>%
    dplyr::select(iteration, diagnosis, investment, metric, value) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diagnosis, values_from = value) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `BPD-CC` = BPD - CC,
      `AD-CC` = AD - CC,
      `AD-BPD` = AD - BPD
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      iteration, investment, metric,
      `BPD-CC`, `AD-CC`, `AD-BPD`
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(`BPD-CC`, `AD-CC`, `AD-BPD`),
      names_to = "contrast",
      values_to = "difference"
    )
  point_contrasts <- point %>%
    dplyr::filter(metric %in% inferential_metrics) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diagnosis, values_from = value) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `BPD-CC` = BPD - CC,
      `AD-CC` = AD - CC,
      `AD-BPD` = AD - BPD
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      investment, metric, `BPD-CC`, `AD-CC`, `AD-BPD`
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(`BPD-CC`, `AD-CC`, `AD-BPD`),
      names_to = "contrast",
      values_to = "point_difference"
    )
  contrasts <- contrast_draws %>%
    dplyr::group_by(investment, metric, contrast) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      bootstrap_mean = mean(difference),
      lower = stats::quantile(difference, 0.025),
      upper = stats::quantile(difference, 0.975),
      p_two_sided = min(
        1,
        2 * (
          min(sum(difference <= 0), sum(difference >= 0)) + 1
        ) / (dplyr::n() + 1)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      correction_family = trustee_bootstrap_correction_family(metric)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(correction_family) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_holm_family = stats::p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "holm")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      point_contrasts,
      by = c("investment", "metric", "contrast")
    )
  list(levels = levels, contrasts = contrasts, draws = draws)
}

trustee_decoded_occupancy_analysis <- function(data) {
  categories <- c(
    "clearly_low_return", "near_one_third", "cooperative"
  )
  subject <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      category = factor(
        dplyr::case_when(
          posterior_state == 1L ~ "clearly_low_return",
          posterior_state == 2L ~ "near_one_third",
          TRUE ~ "cooperative"
        ),
        levels = categories
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(subject_ID, group, category, name = "trials") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subject_ID, group) %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      category = factor(categories, levels = categories),
      fill = list(trials = 0)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(proportion = trials / sum(trials)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  summary <- subject %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group, category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      subjects = dplyr::n_distinct(subject_ID),
      mean_proportion = mean(proportion),
      sd_proportion = stats::sd(proportion),
      median_proportion = stats::median(proportion),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  tests <- purrr::map_dfr(categories, function(category_name) {
    current <- subject %>%
      dplyr::filter(category == category_name)
    fitted <- stats::aov(proportion ~ group, data = current)
    tidy_fit <- broom::tidy(fitted)
    group_row <- tidy_fit %>% dplyr::filter(term == "group")
    tibble::tibble(
      category = category_name,
      numerator_df = group_row$df,
      denominator_df = tidy_fit %>%
        dplyr::filter(term == "Residuals") %>%
        dplyr::pull(df),
      F = group_row$statistic,
      p = group_row$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_holm_across_categories = stats::p.adjust(p, method = "holm")
    )
  pairs <- purrr::map_dfr(categories, function(category_name) {
    current <- subject %>%
      dplyr::filter(category == category_name)
    fitted <- stats::aov(proportion ~ group, data = current)
    as.data.frame(emmeans::contrast(
      emmeans::emmeans(fitted, ~ group),
      "pairwise",
      adjust = "holm"
    )) %>%
      tibble::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        category = category_name,
        contrast,
        difference = estimate,
        SE,
        df,
        t_ratio = t.ratio,
        p_holm_within_category = p.value
      )
  })
  list(subject = subject, summary = summary, tests = tests, pairs = pairs)
}

trustee_safe_decoded_glmm <- function(
    data, outcome, event, include_start_state = FALSE) {
  formula <- stats::as.formula(paste0(
    outcome,
    " ~ diag * inv_sc + gap_sc",
    if (include_start_state) " + start_state" else "",
    " + (1 | subject_ID)"
  ))
  warnings_seen <- character()
  fitted <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      lme4::glmer(
        formula,
        data = data,
        family = stats::binomial,
        control = lme4::glmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6),
          check.conv.singular = "ignore"
        )
      ),
      warning = function(condition) {
        warnings_seen <<- c(
          warnings_seen, conditionMessage(condition)
        )
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(condition) condition
  )
  if (inherits(fitted, "error")) {
    return(list(
      status = tibble::tibble(
        event = event,
        status = "failed",
        detail = conditionMessage(fitted)
      ),
      predictions = tibble::tibble(),
      contrasts = tibble::tibble(),
      coefficients = tibble::tibble()
    ))
  }
  at_values <- list(
    inv_sc = attr(data, "investment_scaled_grid"),
    gap_sc = 0
  )
  marginal <- emmeans::emmeans(
    fitted,
    ~ diag | inv_sc,
    at = at_values,
    weights = "proportional"
  )
  prediction_raw <- as.data.frame(summary(
    marginal,
    type = "response",
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  ))
  probability_column <- intersect(
    c("prob", "response"), names(prediction_raw)
  )[[1]]
  lower_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.LCL", "lower.CL"), names(prediction_raw)
  )[[1]]
  upper_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.UCL", "upper.CL"), names(prediction_raw)
  )[[1]]
  predictions <- prediction_raw %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      event = event,
      diagnosis = as.character(diag),
      inv_sc,
      predicted_probability = .data[[probability_column]],
      lower = .data[[lower_column]],
      upper = .data[[upper_column]]
    )
  contrast_raw <- as.data.frame(summary(
    emmeans::contrast(
      marginal,
      "pairwise",
      by = "inv_sc",
      adjust = "none"
    ),
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
    adjust = "none"
  ))
  contrast_lower <- intersect(
    c("asymp.LCL", "lower.CL"), names(contrast_raw)
  )[[1]]
  contrast_upper <- intersect(
    c("asymp.UCL", "upper.CL"), names(contrast_raw)
  )[[1]]
  contrasts <- contrast_raw %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      event = event,
      inv_sc,
      contrast,
      log_odds_difference = estimate,
      standard_error = SE,
      odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
      lower_odds_ratio = exp(.data[[contrast_lower]]),
      upper_odds_ratio = exp(.data[[contrast_upper]]),
      p_raw = p.value
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(inv_sc) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_holm_within_investment = stats::p.adjust(p_raw, method = "holm")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  coefficients <- as.data.frame(summary(fitted)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      event = event,
      term,
      estimate = Estimate,
      standard_error = `Std. Error`,
      z = `z value`,
      p = `Pr(>|z|)`
    )
  convergence <- fitted@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
  details <- c(warnings_seen, convergence)
  list(
    status = tibble::tibble(
      event = event,
      status = if (length(details)) "warning" else "ok",
      detail = if (length(details)) {
        paste(unique(details), collapse = " | ")
      } else {
        ""
      },
      observations = nrow(data),
      subjects = dplyr::n_distinct(data$subject_ID),
      event_rate = mean(data[[outcome]]),
      singular = lme4::isSingular(fitted)
    ),
    predictions = predictions,
    contrasts = contrasts,
    coefficients = coefficients
  )
}

trustee_decoded_transition_analysis <- function(data) {
  transitions <- data %>%
    dplyr::arrange(subject_ID, round) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subject_ID) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      next_state = dplyr::lead(posterior_state),
      next_investment_analysis = dplyr::lead(investment),
      current_gap = return - fair_return
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(next_state),
      !is.na(next_investment_analysis)
    )
  investment_mean <- mean(transitions$next_investment_analysis)
  investment_sd <- stats::sd(transitions$next_investment_analysis)
  gap_mean <- mean(transitions$current_gap, na.rm = TRUE)
  gap_sd <- stats::sd(transitions$current_gap, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(investment_sd) || investment_sd == 0) investment_sd <- 1
  if (!is.finite(gap_sd) || gap_sd == 0) gap_sd <- 1
  scaled_grid <- (
    trustee_analysis_investments - investment_mean
  ) / investment_sd
  add_covariates <- function(input) {
    output <- input %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        diag = factor(group, levels = trustee_analysis_diagnoses),
        inv_sc = (
          next_investment_analysis - investment_mean
        ) / investment_sd,
        gap_sc = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(current_gap),
          NA_real_,
          (current_gap - gap_mean) / gap_sd
        )
      )
    attr(output, "investment_scaled_grid") <- scaled_grid
    output
  }
  retention <- transitions %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      posterior_state %in% trustee_analysis_groups$cooperative
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stay_cooperative = as.integer(
        next_state %in% trustee_analysis_groups$cooperative
      )
    ) %>%
    add_covariates()
  entry_state_1 <- transitions %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      posterior_state == trustee_analysis_groups$clearly_low_return
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      enter_cooperative = as.integer(
        next_state %in% trustee_analysis_groups$cooperative
      )
    ) %>%
    add_covariates()
  entry_state_2 <- transitions %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      posterior_state == trustee_analysis_groups$near_one_third
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      enter_cooperative = as.integer(
        next_state %in% trustee_analysis_groups$cooperative
      )
    ) %>%
    add_covariates()
  exit_state_1 <- transitions %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      posterior_state %in% trustee_analysis_groups$cooperative
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      destination_event = as.integer(
        next_state == trustee_analysis_groups$clearly_low_return
      ),
      start_state = factor(posterior_state)
    ) %>%
    add_covariates()
  exit_state_2 <- transitions %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      posterior_state %in% trustee_analysis_groups$cooperative
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      destination_event = as.integer(
        next_state == trustee_analysis_groups$near_one_third
      ),
      start_state = factor(posterior_state)
    ) %>%
    add_covariates()
  analyses <- list(
    trustee_safe_decoded_glmm(
      retention, "stay_cooperative", "retention"
    ),
    trustee_safe_decoded_glmm(
      entry_state_1,
      "enter_cooperative",
      "entry_from_clearly_low_return"
    ),
    trustee_safe_decoded_glmm(
      entry_state_2,
      "enter_cooperative",
      "entry_from_near_one_third"
    ),
    trustee_safe_decoded_glmm(
      exit_state_1,
      "destination_event",
      "exit_to_clearly_low_return",
      include_start_state = TRUE
    ),
    trustee_safe_decoded_glmm(
      exit_state_2,
      "destination_event",
      "exit_to_near_one_third",
      include_start_state = TRUE
    )
  )
  list(
    status = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(analyses, `[[`, "status")),
    predictions = dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(analyses, `[[`, "predictions")
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        investment = trustee_analysis_investments[
          match(inv_sc, scaled_grid)
        ]
      ),
    contrasts = dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(analyses, `[[`, "contrasts")
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        investment = trustee_analysis_investments[
          match(inv_sc, scaled_grid)
        ]
      ),
    coefficients = dplyr::bind_rows(
      lapply(analyses, `[[`, "coefficients")
    )
  )
}

trustee_run_corrected_five_state_analysis <- function(
    model, data, bootstrap_draws = 10000L, seed = 11L) {
  if (nstates(model) != 5L) stop("The corrected analysis requires five states")
  if (nrow(data) != 8940L ||
      any(dplyr::count(data, subject_ID)$n != 10L)) {
    stop("Expected 894 trustee sequences with ten rounds each")
  }
  means <- trustee_expected_state_means(model)
  if (!all(diff(means) > 0) ||
      !identical(which(means >= 0.40), 3:5)) {
    stop("The fitted state means do not support the approved grouping")
  }
  state_dictionary <- tibble::tibble(
    state_count = 5L,
    state = 1:5,
    expected_return_fraction = means,
    category = c(
      "clearly_low_return",
      "near_one_third",
      rep("cooperative", 3)
    )
  )
  emission_grid <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(5L), function(state) {
    return_fraction <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 61L)
    response_parameters <- getpars(model@response[[state]][[1]])
    emission_probability <- as.numeric(dens(vtdgaus(
      return_fraction,
      yield = rep(60, length(return_fraction)),
      pstart = response_parameters
    )))
    tibble::tibble(
      state = state,
      return_fraction = return_fraction,
      probability = emission_probability
    )
  })
  emission_error <- emission_grid %>%
    dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(error = abs(sum(probability) - 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::summarise(error = max(error)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(error)
  if (emission_error > 1e-10) stop("Emission probabilities do not normalize")

  smoothed <- tibble::as_tibble(
    posterior(model, type = "smoothing"),
    .name_repair = ~ paste0("state_", seq_along(.x))
  )
  probability_weighted_state <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    data %>% dplyr::select(subject_ID, group, type),
    smoothed
  ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      dplyr::starts_with("state_"),
      names_to = "state_label",
      values_to = "posterior_probability"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = as.integer(sub("state_", "", state_label))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subject_ID, group, type, state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      occupancy = mean(posterior_probability),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  probability_weighted_category <- probability_weighted_state %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      category = dplyr::case_when(
        state == 1L ~ "clearly_low_return",
        state == 2L ~ "near_one_third",
        TRUE ~ "cooperative"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subject_ID, group, type, category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(occupancy = sum(occupancy), .groups = "drop")
  probability_weighted_summary <- probability_weighted_category %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group, category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      participants = dplyr::n(),
      mean_occupancy = mean(occupancy),
      standard_error = stats::sd(occupancy) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  probability_weighted_pairs <- probability_weighted_category %>%
    dplyr::group_split(category) %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(function(category_data) {
      fitted <- stats::lm(occupancy ~ group, data = category_data)
      as.data.frame(summary(
        emmeans::contrast(
          emmeans::emmeans(fitted, ~ group),
          "pairwise",
          adjust = "holm"
        ),
        infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
      )) %>%
        tibble::as_tibble() %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          category = unique(category_data$category),
          contrast,
          difference = estimate,
          lower = lower.CL,
          upper = upper.CL,
          p_holm = p.value
        )
    })
  decoded_data <- data
  decoded_data$posterior_state <- posterior(model, type = "local")
  decoded_occupancy <- trustee_decoded_occupancy_analysis(decoded_data)
  decoded_transitions <- trustee_decoded_transition_analysis(decoded_data)

  point <- trustee_direct_metric_grid(model, data)
  expected_transitions <- trustee_expected_transitions(model, data)
  frames <- trustee_build_transition_frames(
    model, data, expected_transitions
  )
  transition_blocks <- lapply(frames, trustee_fit_transition_block)
  if (any(vapply(transition_blocks, is.null, logical(1)))) {
    stop("At least one transition-summary block failed")
  }
  transition_summary_point <- trustee_transition_metric_grid(
    transition_blocks
  )
  point_agreement <- point %>%
    dplyr::rename(direct_fitted_model = value) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      transition_summary_point %>%
        dplyr::rename(transition_summary_model = value),
      by = c("diagnosis", "investment", "metric")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      absolute_difference = abs(
        direct_fitted_model - transition_summary_model
      )
    )
  if (nrow(point_agreement) != nrow(point) ||
      any(!is.finite(point_agreement$absolute_difference)) ||
      max(point_agreement$absolute_difference) > 0.005) {
    stop("Transition-summary model does not reproduce the fitted HMM")
  }

  bootstrap <- NULL
  bootstrap_status <- tibble::tibble(
    requested_successful_draws = bootstrap_draws,
    successful_draws = 0L,
    attempted_draws = 0L,
    rejected_draws = 0L
  )
  if (bootstrap_draws > 0L) {
    set.seed(seed)
    storage <- vector("list", bootstrap_draws)
    successful <- 0L
    attempted <- 0L
    maximum_attempts <- max(
      bootstrap_draws * 5L,
      bootstrap_draws + 100L
    )
    while (successful < bootstrap_draws && attempted < maximum_attempts) {
      attempted <- attempted + 1L
      simulated_blocks <- lapply(
        transition_blocks,
        trustee_simulate_transition_block
      )
      if (any(vapply(simulated_blocks, is.null, logical(1)))) next
      candidate <- tryCatch(
        trustee_transition_metric_grid(simulated_blocks),
        error = function(condition) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(candidate) || any(!is.finite(candidate$value))) next
      successful <- successful + 1L
      storage[[successful]] <- candidate %>%
        dplyr::mutate(iteration = successful)
    }
    bootstrap_status <- tibble::tibble(
      requested_successful_draws = bootstrap_draws,
      successful_draws = successful,
      attempted_draws = attempted,
      rejected_draws = attempted - successful
    )
    if (successful != bootstrap_draws) {
      stop("Could not obtain the requested number of bootstrap draws")
    }
    draws <- dplyr::bind_rows(storage)
    expected_rows <- bootstrap_draws *
      length(trustee_analysis_diagnoses) *
      length(trustee_analysis_investments) * 8L
    if (nrow(draws) != expected_rows || any(!is.finite(draws$value))) {
      stop("Bootstrap draws are incomplete or non-finite")
    }
    bootstrap <- trustee_summarise_bootstrap(draws, point)
  }
  list(
    state_count = 5L,
    state_groups = trustee_analysis_groups,
    state_dictionary = state_dictionary,
    emission_grid = emission_grid,
    probability_weighted_occupancy = list(
      state = probability_weighted_state,
      category = probability_weighted_category,
      summary = probability_weighted_summary,
      pairs = probability_weighted_pairs
    ),
    occupancy = decoded_occupancy,
    decoded = decoded_transitions,
    point = point,
    transition_summary_point = transition_summary_point,
    direct_vs_transition_summary_agreement = point_agreement,
    bootstrap = bootstrap,
    bootstrap_status = bootstrap_status,
    seed = seed,
    provenance = list(
      implementation =
        "analysis_main.Rmd:trustee-corrected-five-state-recompute-functions",
      model_parameter_sha256 = digest::digest(
        getpars(model), algo = "sha256"
      ),
      behavioral_data_sha256 = digest::digest(
        file = file.path("Data", "full_RTG_data.csv"),
        algo = "sha256"
      ),
      transition_orientation =
        "depmix_xi_to_from_transposed_to_from_to"
    ),
    transition_orientation =
      "depmix_xi_to_from_transposed_to_from_to",
    generated_at = Sys.time()
  )
}
```

```{r trustee-corrected-five-state-artifact, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
# Authenticate the corrected five-state analysis against the model selected by
# the standardized search, then reconstruct the primary and secondary
# summaries from the stored bootstrap draws. A separate chunk below contains
# the complete code for regenerating those draws from the fitted HMM.
trustee_selected_model <- order_mod_vtdgaus(
  selected_trustee_contrast_model
)
trustee_selected_parameter_hash <- digest::digest(
  getpars(trustee_selected_model),
  algo = "sha256"
)
# The selected five-state fit (perturbed_warm_02 from the model search) is
# the model every reported trustee number derives from in the ordinary render.
trustee_canonical_five_state <- list(
  fit_label = "perturbed_warm_02",
  parameter_sha256 =
    "900b4eb383d71c4e5fa6ad5512cc54a67875a331eafb731cbb97194478a00cef",
  log_likelihood = -26138.028102
)
trustee_corrected_recompute <- identical(
  Sys.getenv("VTC_TRUSTEE_BOOTSTRAP_RECOMPUTE"), "1"
) || identical(Sys.getenv("VTC_HMM_FULL_RECOMPUTE"), "1") ||
  trustee_full_recompute
trustee_selected_state_means <- trustee_expected_state_means(
  trustee_selected_model
)
# In either mode the ordered states must keep the economic classes used in the
# text: State 1 clearly below one third, State 2 near one third, and States
# 3-5 at or above the 40% cooperative boundary.
stopifnot(
  identical(selected_trustee_contrast_states, 5L),
  identical(nstates(trustee_selected_model), 5L),
  all(diff(trustee_selected_state_means) > 0),
  trustee_selected_state_means[[1]] < 0.25,
  abs(trustee_selected_state_means[[2]] - 1 / 3) <= 0.05,
  all(trustee_selected_state_means[3:5] >= 0.40)
)
if (trustee_corrected_recompute) {
  # A refitted search cannot promise a bit-identical optimum, so recomputation
  # is accepted when it selects five states under both BIC conventions and
  # reaches the canonical log-likelihood within a declared tolerance. The
  # tolerance is checked in both directions: a clearly better optimum would
  # mean the canonical fit is no longer the highest-likelihood solution.
  trustee_recompute_ll_tolerance <- as.numeric(
    Sys.getenv("VTC_TRUSTEE_RECOMPUTE_LL_TOLERANCE", "5")
  )
  stopifnot(
    is.finite(trustee_recompute_ll_tolerance),
    trustee_recompute_ll_tolerance > 0
  )
  trustee_recomputed_log_likelihood <- as.numeric(
    logLik(trustee_selected_model)
  )
  trustee_recompute_selected <- function(criterion) {
    summary_rows <- trustee_search_result$selection_summary
    as.integer(summary_rows$selected_state_count[
      summary_rows$criterion == criterion
    ][[1]])
  }
  trustee_recompute_divergence <- tibble::tibble(
    canonical_fit_label = trustee_canonical_five_state$fit_label,
    canonical_parameter_sha256 = trustee_canonical_five_state$parameter_sha256,
    recomputed_parameter_sha256 = trustee_selected_parameter_hash,
    parameter_hash_matches_canonical = identical(
      trustee_selected_parameter_hash,
      trustee_canonical_five_state$parameter_sha256
    ),
    canonical_log_likelihood = trustee_canonical_five_state$log_likelihood,
    recomputed_log_likelihood = trustee_recomputed_log_likelihood,
    log_likelihood_difference = trustee_recomputed_log_likelihood -
      trustee_canonical_five_state$log_likelihood,
    log_likelihood_tolerance = trustee_recompute_ll_tolerance,
    selected_states_bic_trials = trustee_recompute_selected("BIC_trials"),
    selected_states_bic_sequences =
      trustee_recompute_selected("BIC_sequences"),
    state_means = paste(
      sprintf("%.4f", trustee_selected_state_means), collapse = ";"
    ),
    search_reused = isTRUE(trustee_search_reuse),
    generated_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
  )
  trustee_recompute_divergence_path <- file.path(
    "results", "HMM", "recomputed_from_analysis_main",
    "five_state_recompute_divergence.csv"
  )
  dir.create(
    dirname(trustee_recompute_divergence_path),
    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    trustee_recompute_divergence, trustee_recompute_divergence_path
  )
  cat(
    sprintf(
      paste0(
        "Recomputed five-state trustee fit: log-likelihood %.3f versus ",
        "canonical %.3f (difference %+.3f, tolerance %.1f); parameter hash ",
        "%s the canonical fit; BIC selects %d (trials) and %d (sequences) ",
        "states.\n"
      ),
      trustee_recomputed_log_likelihood,
      trustee_canonical_five_state$log_likelihood,
      trustee_recompute_divergence$log_likelihood_difference,
      trustee_recompute_ll_tolerance,
      if (trustee_recompute_divergence$parameter_hash_matches_canonical) {
        "matches"
      } else {
        "differs from"
      },
      trustee_recompute_divergence$selected_states_bic_trials,
      trustee_recompute_divergence$selected_states_bic_sequences
    ),
    file = stderr()
  )
  stopifnot(
    identical(trustee_recompute_divergence$selected_states_bic_trials, 5L),
    identical(trustee_recompute_divergence$selected_states_bic_sequences, 5L),
    abs(trustee_recompute_divergence$log_likelihood_difference) <=
      trustee_recompute_ll_tolerance
  )
} else {
  # The ordinary render loads archived bootstrap draws below; they belong to
  # the canonical fit, so the model in hand must be exactly that fit.
  stopifnot(identical(
    trustee_selected_parameter_hash,
    trustee_canonical_five_state$parameter_sha256
  ))
}

trustee_resolve_recorded_repo_path <- function(recorded_path) {
  marker <- regexpr("results/HMM/", recorded_path, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (marker < 1L) {
    stop("Recorded artifact path is not inside results/HMM: ", recorded_path)
  }
  relative_path <- substring(recorded_path, marker)
  resolved_path <- normalizePath(relative_path, mustWork = TRUE)
  repository_root <- normalizePath(".", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!startsWith(
    resolved_path,
    paste0(repository_root, .Platform$file.sep)
  )) {
    stop("Resolved artifact is outside the repository: ", resolved_path)
  }
  resolved_path
}

# summaries use the same draws and their specified comparison families.
trustee_precision_path <- file.path(
  "results", "HMM", "neutral_precision_2026-09-30", "B10000",
  "pooled_result_B10000.rds"
)
stopifnot(identical(
  digest::digest(file = trustee_precision_path, algo = "sha256"),
  "1e9af5e7b7c952154a299ab922e6887ee437cd769ab2b122f622ab925f527d9f"
))
trustee_precision_result <- readRDS(trustee_precision_path)
trustee_precision_seeds <- vapply(
  trustee_precision_result$manifest$jobs, function(job) job$seed, integer(1)
)
stopifnot(
  identical(trustee_precision_seeds, 11:18),
  trustee_precision_result$manifest$total_requested == 10000L,
  trustee_precision_result$manifest$draws_per_worker == 1250L,
  length(trustee_precision_result$manifest$exit_codes) == 8L,
  all(unlist(trustee_precision_result$manifest$exit_codes) == 0L),
  identical(
    trustee_precision_result$manifest$analysis_script_sha256,
    trustee_corrected_manifest_value("analysis_script_sha256")
  ),
  isTRUE(all.equal(
    trustee_precision_result$point,
    trustee_corrected_result$point,
    tolerance = 0
  ))
)
trustee_corrected_result$bootstrap <- trustee_precision_result$bootstrap
trustee_corrected_result$bootstrap_status <- tibble::tibble(
  requested_successful_draws = 10000L,
  successful_draws = 10000L,
  attempted_draws = 10000L,
  rejected_draws = 0L
)
# A pooled run has multiple seeds; do not retain the archive's single-seed label.
trustee_corrected_result$seed <- NULL
trustee_corrected_result$bootstrap_seeds <- trustee_precision_seeds
trustee_corrected_result$generated_at <- as.POSIXct(
  trustee_precision_result$manifest$completed_unix,
  origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"
)
trustee_corrected_result$provenance <- list(
  base_analysis_archive = list(
    result_path = trustee_corrected_result_path,
    metadata = trustee_corrected_result$provenance
  ),
  transition_bootstrap = list(
    result_path = trustee_precision_path,
    result_sha256 = digest::digest(file = trustee_precision_path, algo = "sha256"),
    seeds = trustee_precision_seeds,
    status = trustee_corrected_result$bootstrap_status,
    manifest = trustee_precision_result$manifest
  )
)
} else {
  trustee_corrected_result <- trustee_run_corrected_five_state_analysis(
    model = trustee_selected_model,
    data = trustee_dat %>% dplyr::arrange(subject_ID, round),
    bootstrap_draws = trustee_corrected_expected_draws,
    seed = 11L
  )
  trustee_corrected_recompute_path <- Sys.getenv(
    "VTC_TRUSTEE_BOOTSTRAP_OUTPUT",
    file.path(
      "results", "HMM", "recomputed_from_analysis_main",
      sprintf(
        "corrected_five_state_B%d.rds",
        trustee_corrected_expected_draws
      )
    )
  )
  dir.create(
    dirname(trustee_corrected_recompute_path),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  saveRDS(
    trustee_corrected_result,
    trustee_corrected_recompute_path
  )
}
trustee_bootstrap_sampling_description <- if (trustee_corrected_recompute) {

    format(trustee_corrected_expected_draws, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
  )
} else {
  paste(
    "We obtained 10,000 successful samples in eight independently seeded",
    "batches of 1,250 samples (seeds 11–18), pooling the samples before",
    "calculating confidence intervals and tests."
  )
}

  "probability_weighted_occupancy", "occupancy", "decoded", "point",

)

  } else {
    identical(trustee_corrected_result$bootstrap_seeds, 11:18)
  },
  identical(

  ),
  identical(
    trustee_corrected_result$state_groups$clearly_low_return,
    1L
  ),
  identical(trustee_corrected_result$state_groups$near_one_third, 2L),
  identical(trustee_corrected_result$state_groups$cooperative, 3:5),
  nrow(trustee_corrected_result$point) == 72L,
  nrow(trustee_corrected_result$bootstrap$draws) ==
    trustee_corrected_expected_draws * 72L,
  length(unique(
    trustee_corrected_result$bootstrap$draws$iteration
  )) == trustee_corrected_expected_draws,

trustee_split_metrics <- c(
  "retention",
  "entry_from_clearly_low_return",
  "entry_from_near_one_third",
  "exit_to_clearly_low_return",
  "exit_to_near_one_third",
  "stationary_cooperation",
  "stationary_clearly_low_return",
  "stationary_near_one_third"
)
trustee_point_split <- trustee_corrected_result$point %>%
  dplyr::select(diagnosis, investment, metric, value)
trustee_draws_split <- trustee_corrected_result$bootstrap$draws %>%
  dplyr::select(iteration, diagnosis, investment, metric, value)
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(trustee_point_split[c(
    "diagnosis", "investment", "metric"
  )]),
  !anyDuplicated(trustee_draws_split[c(
    "iteration", "diagnosis", "investment", "metric"
  )]),
  setequal(trustee_point_split$metric, trustee_split_metrics),
  setequal(trustee_draws_split$metric, trustee_split_metrics),
  all(is.finite(trustee_point_split$value)),
  all(is.finite(trustee_draws_split$value))
)

trustee_split_correction_family <- function(metric) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    metric %in% c(
      "retention",
      "entry_from_clearly_low_return",
      "entry_from_near_one_third"
    ) ~ "retention_and_entry",
    metric %in% c(
      "exit_to_clearly_low_return",
      "exit_to_near_one_third"
    ) ~ "exit_destination",
    metric == "stationary_cooperation" ~ "stationary_cooperation",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

trustee_make_pairwise_contrasts <- function(
    data, value_column, include_iteration = FALSE) {
  identifiers <- c(
    if (include_iteration) "iteration",
    "investment", "metric"
  )
  data %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(identifiers),
      diagnosis,
      value = dplyr::all_of(value_column)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diagnosis, values_from = value) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `BPD-CC` = BPD - CC,
      `AD-CC` = AD - CC,
      `AD-BPD` = AD - BPD
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(identifiers),
      `BPD-CC`, `AD-CC`, `AD-BPD`
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(`BPD-CC`, `AD-CC`, `AD-BPD`),
      names_to = "contrast",
      values_to = if (include_iteration) {
        "difference"
      } else {
        "point_difference"
      }
    )
}

trustee_split_levels <- trustee_draws_split %>%
  dplyr::group_by(diagnosis, investment, metric) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    bootstrap_mean = mean(value),
    lower = stats::quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper = stats::quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    trustee_point_split %>% dplyr::rename(point_estimate = value),
    by = c("diagnosis", "investment", "metric")
  )

trustee_split_draw_contrasts <- trustee_make_pairwise_contrasts(
  trustee_draws_split %>%
    dplyr::filter(metric %in% c(
      "retention",
      "entry_from_clearly_low_return",
      "entry_from_near_one_third",
      "exit_to_clearly_low_return",
      "exit_to_near_one_third",
      "stationary_cooperation"
    )),
  "value",
  include_iteration = TRUE
)
trustee_split_point_contrasts <- trustee_make_pairwise_contrasts(
  trustee_point_split %>%
    dplyr::filter(metric %in% c(
      "retention",
      "entry_from_clearly_low_return",
      "entry_from_near_one_third",
      "exit_to_clearly_low_return",
      "exit_to_near_one_third",
      "stationary_cooperation"
    )),
  "value"
)
trustee_split_contrasts <- trustee_split_draw_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(investment, metric, contrast) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    bootstrap_mean = mean(difference),
    lower = stats::quantile(difference, 0.025),
    upper = stats::quantile(difference, 0.975),
    p_two_sided = min(
      1,
      2 * (
        min(sum(difference <= 0), sum(difference >= 0)) + 1
      ) / (dplyr::n() + 1)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    correction_family = trustee_split_correction_family(metric)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(correction_family) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_holm_family = stats::p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "holm")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    trustee_split_point_contrasts,
    by = c("investment", "metric", "contrast")
  )
stopifnot(
  nrow(trustee_split_levels) == 72L,
  nrow(trustee_split_contrasts) == 54L,
  identical(
    as.integer(table(trustee_split_contrasts$correction_family)[
      c(
        "exit_destination",
        "retention_and_entry",
        "stationary_cooperation"
      )
    ]),
    c(18L, 27L, 9L)
  )
)

# State 1 is the exploitative state, State 2 is neutral and approximately
# investor-break-even, and States 3-5 are cooperative. The primary transition
# outcomes therefore use State 1 alone for repair and exploitative exit.
trustee_primary_metric_names <- c(
  "entry_from_clearly_low_return",
  "retention",
  "exit_to_clearly_low_return",
  "stationary_cooperation"
)
trustee_primary_point_estimates <- trustee_point_split %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric %in% trustee_primary_metric_names)
trustee_primary_draws <- trustee_draws_split %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric %in% trustee_primary_metric_names)
trustee_primary_levels <- trustee_split_levels %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric %in% trustee_primary_metric_names)

# Retention and repair form one planned 18-comparison family. Exploitative and
# neutral exits are adjusted together before the exploitative-exit rows are
# retained for the primary figure. Long-run cooperation forms a 9-comparison
# family.
trustee_primary_retention_repair_contrasts <-
  trustee_split_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric %in% c(
    "retention", "entry_from_clearly_low_return"
  )) %>%
  dplyr::group_by() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    correction_family = "retention_and_repair",
    p_holm_family = stats::p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "holm")
  )
trustee_primary_exit_contrasts <- trustee_split_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric == "exit_to_clearly_low_return") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(correction_family = "exit_destination")
trustee_primary_long_run_contrasts <- trustee_split_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric == "stationary_cooperation") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(correction_family = "stationary_cooperation")
trustee_primary_contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  trustee_primary_retention_repair_contrasts,
  trustee_primary_exit_contrasts,
  trustee_primary_long_run_contrasts
)
stopifnot(
  nrow(trustee_primary_levels) == 36L,
  nrow(trustee_primary_contrasts) == 36L,
  identical(
    as.integer(table(trustee_primary_contrasts$correction_family)[
      c(
        "exit_destination",
        "retention_and_repair",
        "stationary_cooperation"
      )
    ]),
    c(9L, 18L, 9L)
  )
)

# State 2 transitions are retained as separate neutral-state analyses. Their
# adjusted probabilities preserve the preplanned source/destination scopes:
# neutral entry shares the source-transition family with retention and repair,
# and neutral exit shares the destination family with exploitative exit.
trustee_secondary_metric_names <- c(
  "entry_from_near_one_third",
  "exit_to_near_one_third"
)
trustee_secondary_levels <- trustee_split_levels %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric %in% trustee_secondary_metric_names)
trustee_secondary_contrasts <- trustee_split_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric %in% trustee_secondary_metric_names) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    adjusted_probability_scope = dplyr::case_when(
      correction_family == "retention_and_entry" ~ paste(
        "27 tests: retention, repair from State 1, and movement from neutral",
        "State 2 into cooperation"
      ),
      correction_family == "exit_destination" ~
        "18 tests: exits to exploitative State 1 and neutral State 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
stopifnot(
  nrow(trustee_secondary_levels) == 18L,
  nrow(trustee_secondary_contrasts) == 18L
)
trustee_neutral_entry_ad_cc <- trustee_secondary_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::filter(metric == "entry_from_near_one_third", contrast == "AD-CC")
trustee_neutral_entry_ad_bpd_10_15 <- trustee_secondary_contrasts %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metric == "entry_from_near_one_third", contrast == "AD-BPD",
    investment %in% c(10, 15)
  )
stopifnot(
  nrow(trustee_neutral_entry_ad_cc) == 3L,
  nrow(trustee_neutral_entry_ad_bpd_10_15) == 2L
)
trustee_neutral_entry_ad_cc_p_max <- max(
  trustee_neutral_entry_ad_cc$p_holm_family
)
trustee_neutral_entry_ad_bpd_10_15_p_max <- max(
  trustee_neutral_entry_ad_bpd_10_15$p_holm_family
)

trustee_state_dictionary <- trustee_corrected_result$state_dictionary %>%
  dplyr::arrange(state) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    primary_block = dplyr::case_when(
      state == 1L ~ "exploitative",
      state == 2L ~ "neutral_near_investor_break_even",
      TRUE ~ "cooperative"
    ),
    reader_label = dplyr::case_when(
      state == 1L ~ "Exploitative",
      state == 2L ~ "Neutral / approximately investor-break-even",
      TRUE ~ "Cooperative"
    ),
    investor_receipt_per_invested_token =
      3 * expected_return_fraction,
    investor_incremental_gain_per_invested_token =
      investor_receipt_per_invested_token - 1,
    trustee_retained_per_invested_token =
      3 - investor_receipt_per_invested_token
  )
trustee_state_emission_profiles <- trustee_corrected_result$emission_grid
trustee_probability_weighted_state_occupancy <-
  trustee_corrected_result$probability_weighted_occupancy$state
trustee_probability_weighted_block_occupancy <-
  trustee_corrected_result$probability_weighted_occupancy$category
trustee_probability_weighted_block_summary <-
  trustee_corrected_result$probability_weighted_occupancy$summary
trustee_probability_weighted_block_pairs <-
  trustee_corrected_result$probability_weighted_occupancy$pairs
trustee_decoded_checks <- trustee_corrected_result$decoded

# Assign each round to its most likely state for the descriptive occupancy
# analysis. These assignments are local posterior modes: each round is assigned
# independently to the state with the largest smoothed posterior probability.
trustee_most_likely_state <- as.integer(
  posterior(trustee_selected_model, type = "local")
)
trustee_most_likely_trials <- trustee_dat %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    subject_ID,
    group = factor(group, levels = c("CC", "BPD", "AD")),
    round,
    state = trustee_most_likely_state
  )
trustee_most_likely_state_occupancy <-
  trustee_most_likely_trials %>%
  dplyr::count(subject_ID, group, state, name = "trials") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subject_ID, group) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    state = seq_len(nstates(trustee_selected_model)),
    fill = list(trials = 0L)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(occupancy = trials / sum(trials)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
trustee_most_likely_block_occupancy <-
  trustee_most_likely_state_occupancy %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = dplyr::case_when(
      state == 1L ~ "exploitative",
      state == 2L ~ "neutral",
      TRUE ~ "cooperative"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subject_ID, group, category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    occupancy = sum(occupancy),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
trustee_most_likely_group_state_proportions <-
  trustee_most_likely_trials %>%
  dplyr::count(group, state, name = "trials") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    state = seq_len(nstates(trustee_selected_model)),
    fill = list(trials = 0L)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = trials / sum(trials)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
stopifnot(
  nrow(trustee_state_dictionary) == 5L,
  identical(trustee_state_dictionary$state, 1:5),
  all(diff(trustee_state_dictionary$expected_return_fraction) > 0),
  all(trustee_state_dictionary$expected_return_fraction[3:5] >= 0.40),
  all(trustee_state_dictionary$expected_return_fraction[1:2] < 0.40),
  max(abs(
    trustee_state_emission_profiles %>%
      dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(total = sum(probability), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::pull(total) - 1
  )) < 1e-10,
  nrow(trustee_probability_weighted_state_occupancy) == 894L * 5L,
  length(trustee_most_likely_state) == nrow(trustee_dat),
  all(trustee_most_likely_state %in% 1:5),
  nrow(trustee_most_likely_state_occupancy) == 894L * 5L,
  nrow(trustee_most_likely_group_state_proportions) == 3L * 5L,
  max(abs(
    trustee_probability_weighted_state_occupancy %>%
      dplyr::group_by(subject_ID) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(total = sum(occupancy), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::pull(total) - 1
  )) < 1e-8,
  max(abs(
    trustee_most_likely_state_occupancy %>%
      dplyr::group_by(subject_ID) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(total = sum(occupancy), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::pull(total) - 1
  )) < 1e-12,
  max(abs(
    trustee_most_likely_group_state_proportions %>%
      dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(total = sum(proportion), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::pull(total) - 1
  )) < 1e-12
)

trustee_primary_plot_stars <- function(p_value) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}
trustee_create_primary_transition_panel <- function(
    metric_name, title, y_label, y_limits, bracket_step,
    level_table = trustee_primary_levels,
    contrast_table = trustee_primary_contrasts) {
  level_data <- level_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Investment = factor(
        investment,
        levels = as.numeric(names(trustee_primary_investment_labels)),
        labels = unname(trustee_primary_investment_labels)
      ),
      diagnosis = factor(diagnosis, levels = c("CC", "BPD", "AD"))
    )
  contrast_data <- contrast_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      metric == metric_name,
      p_holm_family < 0.05
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Investment = factor(
        investment,
        levels = as.numeric(names(trustee_primary_investment_labels)),
        labels = unname(trustee_primary_investment_labels)
      ),
      x_base = as.integer(Investment),
      contrast_type = dplyr::case_when(
        contrast == "BPD-CC" ~ "BPD-CC",
        contrast == "AD-CC" ~ "AD-CC",
        contrast == "AD-BPD" ~ "AD-BPD",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      bracket_level = dplyr::case_when(
        contrast_type == "BPD-CC" ~ 1,
        contrast_type == "AD-CC" ~ 2,
        contrast_type == "AD-BPD" ~ 3,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
  stopifnot(
    nrow(level_data) == 9L,
    nrow(contrast_table %>%
      dplyr::filter(metric == metric_name)) == 9L,
    !anyNA(level_data),
    !anyNA(contrast_data)
  )

  if (nrow(contrast_data) > 0L) {
    investment_maxima <- level_data %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Investment) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(maximum_upper = max(upper), .groups = "drop")
    contrast_data <- contrast_data %>%
      dplyr::left_join(investment_maxima, by = "Investment") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Investment) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(bracket_level, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        displayed_bracket_level = dplyr::row_number(),
        bracket_y = maximum_upper +
          bracket_step * 1.8 * displayed_bracket_level,
        label_y = bracket_y + bracket_step * 0.65,
        stars = trustee_primary_plot_stars(p_holm_family)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }

  dodge_width <- 0.7
  dodge <- ggplot2::position_dodge(width = dodge_width)
  panel <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    level_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = Investment,
      y = point_estimate,
      colour = diagnosis,
      shape = diagnosis,
      group = diagnosis
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(position = dodge, size = 3.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
      position = dodge,
      width = 0.16,
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = trustee_group_colours,
      limits = c("CC", "BPD", "AD")
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
      values = trustee_group_shapes,
      limits = c("CC", "BPD", "AD")
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      y = y_label,
      x = NULL,
      colour = "Diagnosis",
      shape = "Diagnosis"
    ) +
    trustee_primary_plot_theme

  required_upper <- max(
    y_limits[[2]],
    level_data$upper,
    if (nrow(contrast_data) > 0L) contrast_data$label_y else y_limits[[2]],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  panel <- panel +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(y_limits[[1]], required_upper + bracket_step),
      labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)
    )

  if (nrow(contrast_data) > 0L) {
    diagnosis_offsets <- c(
      CC = -dodge_width / 3,
      BPD = 0,
      AD = dodge_width / 3
    )
    for (row_index in seq_len(nrow(contrast_data))) {
      row <- contrast_data[row_index, ]
      groups <- strsplit(row$contrast, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      x1 <- row$x_base + diagnosis_offsets[[groups[[2]]]]
      x2 <- row$x_base + diagnosis_offsets[[groups[[1]]]]
      panel <- panel +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "segment",
          x = x1, xend = x2,
          y = row$bracket_y, yend = row$bracket_y,
          colour = "black"
        ) +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "segment",
          x = x1, xend = x1,
          y = row$bracket_y,
          yend = row$bracket_y - bracket_step / 3,
          colour = "black"
        ) +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "segment",
          x = x2, xend = x2,
          y = row$bracket_y,
          yend = row$bracket_y - bracket_step / 3,
          colour = "black"
        ) +
        ggplot2::annotate(
          "text",
          x = (x1 + x2) / 2,
          y = row$label_y,
          label = row$stars,
          size = 5.4
        )
    }
  }
  panel
}
```

```{r trustee-corrected-state-count-sensitivity, include=FALSE, eval=!rtg_state_ready}
# Four- and six-state sensitivity analyses use the same economic classification
# as the five-state analysis. The fitted state nearest one-third return is
# neutral, lower-return states are exploitative, and higher-return states are
# cooperative.
trustee_taxonomy_metrics <- function(
    transition_matrix, exploitative_states, cooperative_states) {
  stationary <- trustee_stationary_distribution(transition_matrix)
  c(
    retention = trustee_weighted_transition_probability(
      transition_matrix,
      stationary,
      cooperative_states,
      cooperative_states
    ),
    repair_from_exploitative = trustee_weighted_transition_probability(
      transition_matrix,
      stationary,
      exploitative_states,
      cooperative_states
    ),
    exit_to_exploitative = trustee_weighted_transition_probability(
      transition_matrix,
      stationary,
      cooperative_states,
      exploitative_states
    ),
    stationary_cooperation = sum(stationary[cooperative_states])
  )
}

trustee_taxonomy_metric_grid <- function(
    transition_blocks, exploitative_states, cooperative_states) {
  purrr::map_dfr(trustee_analysis_diagnoses, function(diagnosis) {
    purrr::map_dfr(trustee_analysis_investments, function(investment) {
      values <- trustee_taxonomy_metrics(
        trustee_compose_transition_matrix(
          transition_blocks, investment, diagnosis
        ),
        exploitative_states,
        cooperative_states
      )
      tibble::tibble(
        diagnosis = diagnosis,
        investment = investment,
        metric = names(values),
        value = as.numeric(values)
      )
    })
  })
}

trustee_direct_taxonomy_metric_grid <- function(
    model, data, exploitative_states, cooperative_states) {
  purrr::map_dfr(trustee_analysis_diagnoses, function(diagnosis) {
    purrr::map_dfr(trustee_analysis_investments, function(investment) {
      values <- trustee_taxonomy_metrics(
        trustee_direct_transition_matrix(
          model, data, investment, diagnosis
        ),
        exploitative_states,
        cooperative_states
      )
      tibble::tibble(
        diagnosis = diagnosis,
        investment = investment,
        metric = names(values),
        value = as.numeric(values)
      )
    })
  })
}

trustee_summarise_sensitivity_draws <- function(draws, point) {
  levels <- draws %>%
    dplyr::group_by(diagnosis, investment, metric) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      bootstrap_mean = mean(value),
      lower = stats::quantile(value, 0.025),
      upper = stats::quantile(value, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      point %>% dplyr::rename(point_estimate = value),
      by = c("diagnosis", "investment", "metric")
    )
  draw_contrasts <- trustee_make_pairwise_contrasts(
    draws,
    "value",
    include_iteration = TRUE
  )
  point_contrasts <- trustee_make_pairwise_contrasts(point, "value")
  contrasts <- draw_contrasts %>%
    dplyr::group_by(investment, metric, contrast) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      bootstrap_mean = mean(difference),
      lower = stats::quantile(difference, 0.025),
      upper = stats::quantile(difference, 0.975),
      p_two_sided = min(
        1,
        2 * (
          min(sum(difference <= 0), sum(difference >= 0)) + 1
        ) / (dplyr::n() + 1)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      correction_family = dplyr::case_when(
        metric %in% c("retention", "repair_from_exploitative") ~
          "retention_and_repair",
        metric == "exit_to_exploitative" ~ "exploitative_exit",
        metric == "stationary_cooperation" ~
          "stationary_cooperation",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(correction_family) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_holm_family = stats::p.adjust(p_two_sided, method = "holm")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      point_contrasts,
      by = c("investment", "metric", "contrast")
    )
  list(levels = levels, contrasts = contrasts, draws = draws)
}

trustee_cooperative_occupancy_analysis <- function(
    model, data, cooperative_states) {
  most_likely_state <- as.integer(posterior(model, type = "local"))
  if (length(most_likely_state) != nrow(data) ||
      any(!most_likely_state %in% seq_len(nstates(model)))) {
    stop("Unexpected most-likely-state assignments")
  }
  participant <- data %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      subject_ID,
      group,
      cooperative_round = as.integer(
        most_likely_state %in% cooperative_states
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subject_ID, group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      cooperative_occupancy = mean(cooperative_round),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  summary <- participant %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      participants = dplyr::n(),
      mean_occupancy = mean(cooperative_occupancy),
      standard_error = stats::sd(cooperative_occupancy) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  fitted <- stats::lm(cooperative_occupancy ~ group, data = participant)
  pairs <- as.data.frame(summary(
    emmeans::contrast(
      emmeans::emmeans(fitted, ~ group),
      "pairwise",
      adjust = "holm"
    ),
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  )) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      contrast,
      difference = estimate,
      lower = lower.CL,
      upper = upper.CL,
      p_holm = p.value
    )
  list(participant = participant, summary = summary, pairs = pairs)
}

trustee_run_state_count_sensitivity <- function(
    model, data, bootstrap_draws = 10000L, seed = 17L) {
  state_count <- nstates(model)
  if (!state_count %in% c(4L, 6L)) {
    stop("Sensitivity requires four or six states")
  }
  means <- trustee_expected_state_means(model)
  neutral_state <- which.min(abs(means - 1 / 3))
  exploitative_states <- which(seq_len(state_count) < neutral_state)
  cooperative_states <- which(seq_len(state_count) > neutral_state)
  if (length(neutral_state) != 1L ||
      !length(exploitative_states) ||
      !length(cooperative_states) ||
      means[neutral_state] < 0.30 ||
      means[neutral_state] > 0.40) {
    stop("Could not identify exploitative, neutral, and cooperative states")
  }
  dictionary <- tibble::tibble(
    state_count = state_count,
    state = seq_len(state_count),
    expected_return_fraction = means,
    broad_category = dplyr::case_when(
      state %in% exploitative_states ~ "exploitative",
      state == neutral_state ~ "neutral",
      state %in% cooperative_states ~ "cooperative",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
  occupancy <- trustee_cooperative_occupancy_analysis(
    model, data, cooperative_states
  )
  point <- trustee_direct_taxonomy_metric_grid(
    model, data, exploitative_states, cooperative_states
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state_count = state_count)
  expected_transitions <- trustee_expected_transitions(model, data)
  frames <- trustee_build_transition_frames(
    model, data, expected_transitions
  )
  blocks <- lapply(frames, trustee_fit_transition_block)
  if (any(vapply(blocks, is.null, logical(1)))) {
    stop("At least one sensitivity transition block failed")
  }
  transition_summary_point <- trustee_taxonomy_metric_grid(
    blocks, exploitative_states, cooperative_states
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(state_count = state_count)
  point_agreement <- point %>%
    dplyr::rename(direct_fitted_model = value) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      transition_summary_point %>%
        dplyr::rename(transition_summary_model = value),
      by = c("state_count", "diagnosis", "investment", "metric")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      absolute_difference = abs(
        direct_fitted_model - transition_summary_model
      )
    )
  if (nrow(point_agreement) != nrow(point) ||
      any(!is.finite(point_agreement$absolute_difference)) ||
      max(point_agreement$absolute_difference) > 0.005) {
    stop("Sensitivity transition summaries do not reproduce the HMM")
  }
  set.seed(seed)
  storage <- vector("list", bootstrap_draws)
  successful <- 0L
  attempted <- 0L
  maximum_attempts <- max(
    bootstrap_draws * 5L,
    bootstrap_draws + 100L
  )
  while (successful < bootstrap_draws && attempted < maximum_attempts) {
    attempted <- attempted + 1L
    simulated_blocks <- lapply(
      blocks, trustee_simulate_transition_block
    )
    if (any(vapply(simulated_blocks, is.null, logical(1)))) next
    candidate <- tryCatch(
      trustee_taxonomy_metric_grid(
        simulated_blocks,
        exploitative_states,
        cooperative_states
      ),
      error = function(condition) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(candidate) || any(!is.finite(candidate$value))) next
    successful <- successful + 1L
    storage[[successful]] <- candidate %>%
      dplyr::mutate(iteration = successful)
  }
  status <- tibble::tibble(
    requested_successful_draws = bootstrap_draws,
    successful_draws = successful,
    attempted_draws = attempted,
    rejected_draws = attempted - successful
  )
  if (successful != bootstrap_draws) {
    stop("Could not obtain the requested sensitivity draws")
  }
  draws <- dplyr::bind_rows(storage)
  if (nrow(draws) != bootstrap_draws * 36L ||
      any(!is.finite(draws$value))) {
    stop("Sensitivity draws are incomplete or non-finite")
  }
  bootstrap <- trustee_summarise_sensitivity_draws(
    draws,
    point %>% dplyr::select(-state_count)
  )
  family_sizes <- table(bootstrap$contrasts$correction_family)
  stopifnot(
    identical(
      as.integer(family_sizes[c(
        "exploitative_exit",
        "retention_and_repair",
        "stationary_cooperation"
      )]),
      c(9L, 18L, 9L)
    )
  )
  list(
    state_count = state_count,
    state_dictionary = dictionary,
    exploitative_states = exploitative_states,
    neutral_state = neutral_state,
    cooperative_states = cooperative_states,
    cooperative_occupancy = occupancy,
    point = point,
    transition_summary_point = transition_summary_point,
    direct_vs_transition_summary_agreement = point_agreement,
    bootstrap = bootstrap,
    bootstrap_status = status,
    provenance = list(
      implementation =
        "analysis_main.Rmd:trustee-corrected-state-count-sensitivity",
      model_parameter_sha256 = digest::digest(
        getpars(model), algo = "sha256"
      ),
      behavioral_data_sha256 = digest::digest(
        file = file.path("Data", "full_RTG_data.csv"),
        algo = "sha256"
      )
    ),
    transition_orientation =
      "depmix_xi_to_from_transposed_to_from_to",
    seed = seed,
    generated_at = Sys.time()
  )
}
```
